name: Give Gerard a Drink
progress:
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water. $B If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
Refreshing Spring Water ( 1 )
completion: Thanks, $N ! And come back if you want to trade again.

name: The Hunt Completed
completion: $N , you have slain all three beasts that comprise the Ashenvale Hunt. You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity. The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended! $B Please, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today. May your ancestors watch over you!

name: Digging Through the Dirt
completion: You dig through the semi-loose dirt over the grave...and find the remains of a coffin. $B Within the coffin you can feel the vibrating scrapes of clawed fingers and the gnashing of rotted teeth... $B Will you open the coffin and retrieve the Embalmer's heart?

name: Distracting Jarven
progress:
Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!
Thunder Ale ( 1 )
completion: For me? You're a true hero, $N !

name: Stranglethorn Fever
details: temp text 02 - description
progress: Witch Doctor Unbagwa know what Mokk the Savage like. Yes, yes! $B Me speak with spirits and make he come, I do. $B But other Gorilla-beast like spirit talkin' too. You protect Witch Doctor Unbagwa and I make he come to you. $B Witch Doctor Unbagwa want something first. You bring 10 Gorilla Fangs and me start spirit talking!
completion: Witch Doctor Unbagwa like Gorilla Fangs! For you I talk to spirits. Make Mokk the Savage come. $B You protect Witch Doctor Unbagwa from other Gorilla-beast though or no Mokk for you!

name: Guarded Thunderbrew Barrel
completion: This barrel of ale is guarded by Jarven Thunderbrew. As long as he's in the basement, no barrels may be disturbed.

name: The Dormant Shade
progress:
This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
Candle of Beckoning ( 1 )
completion: You place the Candle of Beckoning upon the table and light it...

name: Candles of Beckoning
completion: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.

name: Stormwind Library
progress:
King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
Library Scrip ( 1 )
completion: Do any of these titles interest you, $N ?

name: Filling the Soul Gem
progress:
Yenniku stands stunned before you, his mind in another place...
Soul Gem ( 1 )
completion: You place the Soul Gem upon his forehead. He shudders as his soul is sucked in, leaving his body, a mindless husk, behind.

name: Enticing Negolash
progress:
This is an abandoned lifeboat. Printed along its side in scratched, faded paint are the words: $B "Smotts' Revenge"
Barbecued Buzzard Wing ( 10 )
Junglevine Wine ( 5 )
completion: You pile food and drink upon the raft...

name.att: The Monogrammed Sash [Old] - completed with quest 8552

name: Legends of the Earth
details: This book tells the tale of an elemental princess, Myzrael, and of her imprisonment deep underneath the Arathi Highlands. $B It also tells of a secret outcropping of crystals in the highlands. These crystals, the Shards of Myzrael, are a window to the princess' prison. $B If a brave soul found the Shards of Myzrael, the perhaps could speak with her...

name: The Black Box
details: The surface of this metallic black box is heavily pitted, as if it had been immersed in acid - it must have been sitting in the giant condor's stomach for a long time. $B Turning the box over, a symbol is found stamped on its bottom. Below the symbol are the words: $B "Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade"

name: Seal of the Earth
progress:
The Seal of the Earth lies here, with three recessed alcoves for the Amethyst Runestone, the Opal Runestone, and the Diamond Runestone.
Diamond Runestone ( 1 )
Opal Runestone ( 1 )
Amethyst Runestone ( 1 )
completion: As you place the Runestones into the matching recesses, a violent rumbling shakes the earth as the Seal is broken.

name: A Strategic Alliance
details: Thrall is a most wise and noble leader. His tenacity on the battlefield is matched only by his diplomatic tact. $B The Darkspear Trolls have proven to be invaluable allies to orckind. Out of loyalty and honor we have sworn a pact of protection with them. $B The Warchief has sent orders to make sure our Darkspear friends in Sen'jin Village are not under any direct threat. One of their most trusted scouts, Lar Prowltusk is keeping a close watch on their western flank. $B Seek out Lar and assist as needed.

name: Seal of the Earth
progress:
The Seal of the Earth lies here, with three recessed alcoves for the Amethyst Runestone, the Opal Runestone, and the Diamond Runestone.
Diamond Runestone ( 1 )
Opal Runestone ( 1 )
Amethyst Runestone ( 1 )
completion: As you place the Runestones into the matching recesses, a violent rumbling shakes the earth as the Seal is broken.

name: Finding the Antidote
details: Venomtails are some of the deadliest scorpids in Durotar. It was unwise for Rhinag to hunt them without having some of the antidote with him, but right now, chastising is the last thing he needs. $B Bring me a few venomtail poison sacs from any of the venomtails near the entrance of Orgrimmar and I'll make an antidote for him. $B Make haste, $N . One of our own needs your help.
progress: Remember, no matter what creature you hunt, you would do well to study it and understand its behavior. That knowledge could save your life.
completion: Here is the antidote, $N . Take it to Rhinag as soon as you can, and be cautious.

name: Chen's Empty Keg
details: Good stuff, that stormstout, huh? $B I have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more. $B Bring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos. $B Like I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg brew that I mentioned to you before.
progress: You working hard at finding those ingredients, $N ?
completion: Haha! I knew you couldn't resist some of this brew. Come back again anytime you want some more, $N . Just bring me more of the ingredients I had you collect.

name: Another Power Source?
details: Let me guess - you didn't get whatever world-ending, nefarious deed you were doing done in time. No wait, better still... you dropped it in the sand! Well, whatever the reason, I do have additional power sources I will sell to you. This time, however, it will cost you ten, YES TEN Wastewander Water Pouches! $B Times are tough all around, $N , and power sources don't grow on trees! Hrm, but what if they did. Maybe we could MAKE a power source tree...
progress: Well, have you got the ten water pouches?
completion: Very well, here is another power source. I highly recommend you using it properly this time, unless you are eager to spend ten more water pouches for another water source.

name: Spirit of the Wind
progress:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you. $B It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
Blood Shard ( 10 )
completion: Good. Go with Agamaggan's spirit as your guide, $R . Return to me if you desire more of Agamaggan's magics.

name.att: Amongst the Ruins -- Might not exist //Braghe

name: Flawed Power Stone
completion: These stones are infused with magical energy, but purposefully flawed. They are very unstable and once removed from the table they will consume themselves quickly.

name: Onu is meditating
completion: The finding of Twilight's Hammer cultists is troubling. I must meditate on their intentions... $B When you have more information, speak to me through a scrying bowl. If you require a phial of scrying in order to create a bowl, then...here is another.

name: Water Sapta
completion: Take the water sapta and find the corrupted pool of water in Silverpine, $N . I have great faith in your abilities.

name: Corrupted Windblossom
progress:
You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a windblossom plant. The berries that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
Cenarion Plant Salve ( 2 )
completion: You apply two Cenarion plant salves to the windblossom. It immediately begins to shed its corrupted form, blossoming into a vibrant and healthy plant.

name: Corrupted Windblossom
progress:
You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a windblossom plant. The berries that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
Cenarion Plant Salve ( 2 )
completion: You apply two Cenarion plant salves to the windblossom. It immediately begins to shed its corrupted form, blossoming into a vibrant and healthy plant.

name: Call of Water
details: Greetin's, ! Have you too come to purify the waters here and prove your understandin' to Islen? $B I've just defeated the corrupt water spirit meself, and I'm just 'bout to put da bracers and remaining drops o' water on the brazier. $B What's dat? Ahhh. Tiev understan' all too well when somethin' goes wrong. Well, Tiev can help you plenty if you be needin' to see the pure water spirit again. $B Bring me a water sapta from Islen as proof that you be ready, an' I'll wait to turn in me parts.
progress: Ya have the sapta, brotha? $B I know another that had trouble after defeating da corrupt water spirit--seems he waited too long and he came out of the spirit world too quick fer his taste. Hate to see dat happen to another, so I'll just wait here fer a bit to make sure no one else be needin' me help.
completion: Ahhh, den yur ready... $B I'll put me items in the brazier den, and you c'n talk wit' da spirit too. $B An' dontchu worry none 'bout seein' into da spirit world wit' da sapta... ol' Tiev know a trick or two 'bout how da sapta magic works. $B Come now, head down wit' me to the shrine and let's speak to da spirits together, brotha.

name: Fool's Stout
details: So you want some Fool's Stout, eh? Thinking of heading back to the races...? $B All right, bring me more of Zanzil's mixture and I'll make some more stout for you.

name: Under the Chitin Was...
completion: Hey, it's you again! Well, I mean you - as in the you that is $N ! Yes - that you! $B Hey, let me start over! $B That object you found in Silithus - it was in fact a book. It was a journal written in a very ancient dialect of what we now call the Darnassian tongue. It'll take a while, but I'm going to go over it very thoroughly. I thought you should know that what you found was extremely valuable for the Circle. $B The den mother's all excited and everything!

name: Zamek's Distraction
completion: Let's go!

name: Indurium Ore
progress:
I'd like to integrate indurium into different parts of our racers, but I need large amounts of raw indurium to create these parts. $B You can find indurium ore in the Uldaman excavation in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan. $B The gnomes are getting their own supply of it, so it's important we get our own to keep pace with them.
Indurium Ore ( 4 )
completion: Excellent! I'll get the crew to work right away on the parts we'll need for the next race.

name: A Broken Trap
progress:
A large, broken trap lies before you. From the looks of it, the ogres have tried to repair the trap but to no avail. A hastily written note lies next to the trap, and strangely enough it details exactly what is needed to repair it: a thorium widget and some frost oil. Were the trap repaired, an ogre passing near it might get trapped, and could be avoided. $B Clearly, it would seem fortuitous that very few ogres know how to read. $B Clearly.
Thorium Widget ( 1 )
Frost Oil ( 1 )
completion: The thorium widget slides effortlessly into place, creating a conduit to pour the frost oil down. Once the last drops of oil have been emptied into it, the trap snaps into position. $B Woe be to any unwary ogre that should just so happen to wander by!

name: The Missing Diplomat
completion: Let me be first to thank you for all you've done, $N . You have been an incredible blessing to my people and the people of Stormwind. I am sorry I couldn't make your acquaintance under better circumstances. $B Understand also that I cannot overtly thank you for your efforts, but I assure you again, it is appreciated. $B When you visit Theramore in the future, seek me out and I shall try to keep you apprised of the situation. $B Thank you again, $N .

name: Feast at the Blue Recluse
completion: My nephew said you aided him with his research in Dustwallow, and that you helped his associate out of a tight spot. Well, we Sterns stick together and we don't ignore our friends! $B So wash your hands, $N , because we're about to throw a party in your honor!

name: Unfinished Gordok Business
details: Now you da king, so maybe you get prized Gordok artifact back from creepy elf who calls himself Prince! Da king before you failed, just like all da other kings since Tortheldrin - da creepy elf - stole it from old timey Gordok king! $B Artifact is called da Gauntlet of Gordok Might. Old timey stories say only da one true king da Gordok can get it back. Old timey story also say creepy elf is still around here - you find it and it will become mighty gauntlet you wear forever! Yar, I show you!

name: The Lost Supplies
details: This barrel is small yet sturdy. Its seams are sealed with a yellow, pungent wax. Stamped on the bottom of the barrel are the words: $B QUARTERMASTER LUNGERTZ $B NETHERGARDE KEEP
progress: You have something for me?
completion: Ah, thank you $N ! So many supplies are lost from Darkshire to here. It's good to see that some are recovered.

name: Seeking the Kor Gem
details: Greetings, $N . What can I do for one who follows a holy path? $B Ah, yes, Stilwell, the blacksmith... from long ago. I remember him well, though, I have not heard his name in some time. $B He never struck me as an impudent man, so I can only assume his desire for a Kor gem is noble. $B If you truly wish for one of the gems, then you must head to the northwest of Ashenvale. You will find Blackfathom Deeps there within some ancient ruins. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, $C .
progress: I would be less trustful of one not on a holy path if they came asking about a Kor gem. But I trust your kind more than some of my kin. I do not judge your entire order based on the actions of just one of your fallen kind.
completion: This is indeed the gem Stilwell desires, but before I can allow you to bring it to him, it must be purified of corruption--the naga wenches imbue the gems with power, that much is true, but of their own, evil kind. $B Let Stilwell know that its power is intact, and it should work well for whatever ritual he wishes it to be part of. $B I hope you know what you're doing, $C , this is no simple item you possess.

name: Earth Sapta
completion: Take this and remember, it is sacred.

name: Earth Sapta
completion: I give you one in good faith. You already proved yourself once, but me tinkin' you should be more careful in the future.

name: Fire Sapta
completion: May fire burn within your heart, $N . $B The elements await you.

name: Corrupted Windblossom
progress:
You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a windblossom plant. The berries that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
Cenarion Plant Salve ( 2 )
completion: You apply two Cenarion plant salves to the windblossom. It immediately begins to shed its corrupted form, blossoming into a vibrant and healthy plant.

name: Flash Bomb Recipe
completion: So you're an engineer, eh? Well, for your help in getting me those pearls, here's the recipe for flash bombs. $B Good luck, and try not to blind yourself!

name: The Tome of Divinity
completion: Here in Stormwind, I am responsible for putting paladins on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats. $B The time has come for you to take your first step towards being truly virtuous. If you accept it, I will give you a Book of Divinity. In studying it, you shall learn some about the Light, and what is expected of you. If you understand it, and are capable, then you will succeed in attaining greater abilities.

name: The Tome of Divinity
completion: A pleasure to meet you, $N . I am responsible for putting paladins on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats. $B The time has come for you to take your first step towards being truly virtuous. If you accept it, I will give you a Book of Divinity. In studying it, you shall learn some about the Light, and what is expected of you. If you understand it, and are capable, then you will succeed in attaining greater abilities.

name: Bailor's Ore Shipment
details: Ach, ya startled me, ! Can't ya see I was lost in thought? $B What's that? Jordan's shipment... fer Ironforge. Ahhh, yeah, I know whatcha speak of. Mo'grosh ogres... dat's who took me ol' friend's ore shipment. Caravan was headin' here from the Wetlands and was ambushed. The guard who survived their attack just passed away a few days ago--healer couldn't get to 'em fast enough. $B If you want the shipment, you'll have to head northeast across the Loch. It's got to be there somewhere.
progress: So, any luck yet? Haha, those ogres didn't get the best of ya yet, did they?
completion: Yup yup, this is it. Ha! If I'd known you were really gonna head out there and fight some o' them ogres, I woulda given you a list of things to get instead of just this one thing. But, you're not here doin' business for me, are ya?. $B A deal's a deal; Jordan wanted a shipment of me alloy, that's what he's gonna get. $B Tell 'em hello fer me, and be safe, $C .

name: The Tome of Nobility
details: I greet you once again, $N . I am more proud to call you than ever before--your dedication is a tribute to us all. $B The time has come for me to bestow a great gift upon you. But know this, for now I give you this freely, but later, when time permits, this will be a much greater challenge to all paladins who choose to undertake my quest. $B Speak to me again and I shall grant you a great boon.
completion: Congratulations, and may the Light protect you.

name: Grey Iron Weapons
completion: Here are some weapons, hot off the anvil and made with the new umbral ore you brought me! $B Please, $N , take your pick!

name: Weapons of Elunite
completion: $N , I have crafted these weapons with the elunite you brought to me. Please, take whichever most suits you. $B And I must thank you. Working with elunite is both an honor and a pleasure.

name: Grimand's Armor
completion: I can barely believe it! Furen's technique was a success, and this armor should withstand tremendous levels of stress. $B Here you are, $N . And thank you. I wouldn't have believed Furen's discovery if you hadn't gathered the materials I needed to test it myself.

name: Klockmort's Creation
completion: Here's your armor, $N . Furen's process worked brilliantly! Perfectly! Marvelously, truly! $B You could run this armor over with a siege engine and it would spring right back into shape!

name: Mathiel's Armor
completion: I have finished with your piece of armor, and I am quite pleased. Furen's new techniques meshed perfectly with my own and I am sure this armor will prove to be quite resilient. $B Thank you, $N . And may this serve you well in future battles.

name: Essence of the Exile
progress:
The cauldron bubbles. Its vapors beckon...
Thundering Charm ( 8 )
Burning Charm ( 8 )
Cresting Charm ( 8 )
completion: The charms sink slowly into the cauldron's depths... $B A large bubble rises to the surface of the liquid and breaks... $B ...And a churning lump of molten rock is revealed.

name: Furen's Armor
completion: Here's your armor, $N . This will stand up to the strongest assaults or my name isn't Furen Longbeard! $B And I have to thank you. I learned a lot while working with the materials you brought me. I think I'll have another breakthrough one day! $B I'm going to send what I learned to other blacksmiths of the Alliance. $B I'll tell them you were a big help, and maybe they'll want to return the favor.

name: The Symbol of Life
completion: If you fail to help Narm after you've used the Symbol of Life, $N , then return to me and I shall give you another. $B It is important to both my husband and I that you return successful. Please, make haste.

name: The Symbol of Life
completion: Make haste, $N , more than one life hangs in the balance if you fail. $B If for some reason you fail to help Gazin and Henze, then return to me and I will give you another Symbol of Life for your travels. $B Don't mistake my aid as simple charity, you must prove yourself worthy like any other $C and continual failure may reflect upon you later.

name: Whirlwind Weapon
completion: I have the whirlwind heart, and am ready to place it within your vessel of choice. $B Choose your weapon, $N , and know that its power is the power of Cyclonian.

name: The Tome of Valor
completion: It has been proven that the Light is with you, $N , but as times grow more dangerous, it becomes important to know what strength lies beneath the flesh. When demons, dragons, or any other evil set foot in your lands, your mettle will be tested. Will you be strong enough? $B Bravery, regardless of the situation, is as much a part of paladinhood as the Light, your armor, and your weapon. Protecting the weak, and not losing faith are two more lessons you must master while you study in the Cathedral of Light.

name: The Tome of Valor
completion: It has been proven that the Light is with you, $N , but as times grow more dangerous, it becomes important to know what strength lies beneath the flesh. When demons, dragons, or any other evil set foot in your lands, your mettle will be tested. Will you be strong enough? $B Bravery, regardless of the situation, is as much a part of paladinhood as the Light, your armor, and your weapon. Protecting the weak, and not losing faith are two more lessons you must master while you study in the Cathedral of Light.

name: Heirloom Weapon
completion: I will keep three of the weapons you returned to me, as mementos of my pain and loss. But please, $N , choose your favorite of the heirlooms and keep it for yourself. $B May it serve you greater than it served its cursed, former owners.

name: Brutal Gauntlets
completion: Thank you, $N . These gauntlets are my best work. Take them. In wearing them, you bring honor to me and my ancestors.

name: Brutal Helm
completion: I give this helm to you. $B Great deeds brought you to me, $N , and Earthmother willing... even greater deeds lie before you.

name: Brutal Legguards
completion: Here are your legguards, $N . Let me know how they fit or if you need any modifications. I aim to please! At least I used to. $B These days I don't care much for my craft. But it beats being a mindless minion of the Scourge! $B I guess.

name: Brutal Hauberk
completion: I am sure you endured much hardship and shed much blood on my task, $N . Here is the product of your toil. $B May you wear it well, and may you one day return here with stories of its service to you.

name: Water Pouch Bounty
progress:
Back again, $N ? If you have five more Wastewander water pouches, then I have a care package with your name on it!
Wastewander Water Pouch ( 5 )
completion: Excellent - the more water pouches we are able to reclaim, the further away from disaster we'll all be! Keep 'em coming, and I will be sure to reward you for every five water pouches you bring me.

name: Manaweave Robe
completion: Here is your robe. It's one of my best made yet! Wear it with pride, and when people ask... tell them you got it at the Larson Clothiers!

name: Astral Knot Garment
completion: Your garment is ready! And that silk you gathered was so nice... you don't mind if I made it a little short so that I'd have some silk left over for me, do you? $B I'm only joking. It'll fit you great, and will be perfect for both adventure and formal dining. Enjoy!

name: Nether-lace Garment
completion: Here is your nether-lace, $N . It is both comfortable and durable, and holds the magic of the laughing sisters' hair. $B Enjoy, and if you find it amenable, please mention so to Deino. She is a $C on whose good side I wish to stay...

name: Celestial Power
completion: You should be proud of yourself, $N . Many mages have fallen to the creatures you faced. $B The Celestial Orb is ready. Or if you'd like I can mount it atop a staff. It's up to you. I'd prefer the orb, but who am I to judge?

name: Spellfire Robes
completion: Here are your robes, $N . Wear them well.

name: Restoring the Necklace
completion: I gladly give you this necklace, mighty $C . You have done me an invaluable service, and for that I thank you. Wear it with pride, and make sure you mention loudly and repeatedly who made it for you! $B Also, if you could toss in the fact that it really isn't cursed, that would be great.

name: The Sprouted Fronds
completion: The fronds Denalan planted within his garden have sprouted and grown. They tremble, eager to be picked....

name: Kum'isha's Endeavors
details: Even though the portal conjuration was a failure, I remain hopeful that my next attempt will be successful. $B The hope of the Draenei is as fervent as your greed for trinkets, $R . Go back out into these cursed lands and recover another flawless draenethyst sphere. $B Of course, the choice to take on this task is completely left to you *grin*.
progress: Have you found another flawless draenethyst sphere?
completion: Simply amazing. I had doubted that you could find another sphere, yet here it is, pulsating in my hands. $B Well done, $N ! $B Should you find anymore--and I believe this to be an impossibility--return them to me and I shall reward you again.

name: Corrupted Songflower
progress:
You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a songflower plant. A pungent, unhealthy odor emanates from the plant. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
Cenarion Plant Salve ( 2 )
completion: You apply some Cenarion plant salve to the songflower. It immediately begins to shed its corrupted form, blossoming into a vibrant and healthy plant.

name: Rage of Ages
details: Ah, $N , welcome back. It seems you enjoyed the effect of the robust, operational imbue, derived from snickerfang. Be warned, while the immediate effect is a titanic burst of strength, the long term effects on your spirit and intelligence could be hazardous. $B With that said, do you require more? If so, bring me another three snickerfang jowls, two blasted boar lungs, and one scorpok pincer.
progress: Do you have the beast organs?
completion: There you go! Remember, use it sparingly. If you require another, come see me after you finish the one you currently have in your possession.

name: Spirit of the Boar
details: When I first administered the elixir, $N , I could tell that one or two applications would not satiate your appetite. Even now, I can see the hunger in your eyes. The concoction has addictive properties of which, seemingly, the most strong of will cannot resist. $B So be it! Should you require more of the lung juice cocktail, venture back into the wasteland and find for me three blasted boar lungs, two scorpok pincers, and one basilisk brain.
progress: Where are the organs, $N !?
completion: I must warn you, $N , do not attempt to mix the formulas I have created. The chemical properties of the formula you most recently ingested will always take precedence over former enchantments; thus, rendering the other formulation null.

name: Salt of the Scorpok
details: You live! This is good news, indeed. I assume you are back for more of the scorpok assay? $B Very well, $N , back to the wasteland with you and do not return until you have collected three scorpok pincers, two vulture gizzards, and one blasted boar lung.
progress: Where are the organs, $N !?
completion: Fine work, $N . Here is one sample of the assay for you and the remaining nine will be used in my research. $B Anytime you require more of the ground scorpok assay, return to me and we shall work out a deal.

name: Infallible Mind
details: Your focused concentration has dwindled so soon? More research must be done! $B Oh yes, the price remains the same, $N . Venture forth into the blasted lands and return to me with ten brains from the redstone and two vulture gizzards.
progress: Have you returned with the requested organs?
completion: Yes, yes, give me a moment and more of the compound will be ready for your consumption, $N . $B Take it... and $N , do not attempt to consume these experimental concoctions in rapid succession. The results could be disastrous.

name: Spiritual Domination
details: I see that the inner fire has dwindled. Would you say the spiritual euphoria lasted an hour? $B If it's more of the gizzard gum you desire, then more of the gizzards I require. Back to the wastelands, $N . Do not return until you have recovered ten gizzards and two jowls.
progress: Do not waste my time, $N . We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.
completion: Perhaps one day I shall be able to isolate the active enzymes of this assay and produce a much more efficient resultant. Unfortunately, you will have to settle for what I am currently able to produce. Return to me should you require more gizzard gum.

name: The Super Egg-O-Matic
progress:
The Super Egg-O-Matic is the latest of Curgle Cranklehop's inventions. It is quite an impressive piece of machinery. $B The Super Egg-O-Matic sputters wildly as you approach the control panel.
Hippogryph Egg ( 1 )
completion: You place the hippogryph egg into the machine. A series of beeps follows along with some strange mechanical sounds. $B It appears that the Eggometer has weighed, measured, and packaged your egg. Now that's speedy service!

name: An Extraordinary Egg
progress:
I have seen very few eggs retrieved from Feralas in extraordinary condition. These are eggs of the rarest sort...
Extraordinary Egg ( 1 )
completion: Well now, you have one -- amazing! $B I hope you always remember the good you have done today.

name: A Fine Egg
progress:
A fine egg is one that will, in ideal conditions, hatch free of the evil effects of the Gordunni ogres' incantations.
Fine Egg ( 1 )
completion: Very good, $N . I will be sending this egg to Darnassus where I hope it will soon hatch! $B Please accept this as a symbol of my gratitude.

name: An Ordinary Egg
progress:
Ordinary hippogryph eggs hatch about half the time. We do our best to nurture them and with a little luck, they will hatch.
Ordinary Egg ( 1 )
completion: So, you have found an ordinary egg, $N ? Please give it to me... And we can only hope for the best. $B I don't have much, but please accept this reward. If you ever find yourself in Feralas again, know that I am always here to take the eggs you find there.

name: A Bad Egg
progress:
These are the eggs that cannot be saved -- they will never hatch.
Bad Egg ( 1 )
completion: I am afraid I have bad news for you, $N . This egg is too far gone. I can take it from you so that it may be disposed of properly. $B Please don't be discouraged; we cannot save them all. If you find yourself in Feralas again, please try again. Bring another egg for the Super Egg-O-Matic!

name: Corrupted Songflower
progress:
You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a songflower plant. A pungent, unhealthy odor emanates from the plant. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
Cenarion Plant Salve ( 2 )
completion: You apply some Cenarion plant salve to the songflower. It immediately begins to shed its corrupted form, blossoming into a vibrant and healthy plant.

name: Troll Necklace Bounty
progress:
You've done it already, but we will continue to accept any troll tribal necklaces you find and are willing to turn in. By turning them in to me, you'll continue to improve your standing amongst the Wildhammers; if you're willing to fight for us, then we'll be willing to fight for you! $B I need five troll tribal necklaces for them to count, $N .
Troll Tribal Necklace ( 5 )
completion: Another set of necklaces means that there are fewer trolls in the Hinterlands we have to worry about! You've done it again, $N . Keep up the good work!

name: Cuergo's Gold
details: This map shows a stretch of beach with a southern face. Below the map are words, elegantly written... $B South of Wheedle $B South of home $B Find a mast and flag and bones $B Dig you there, if you be bold $B Dig and claim Cuergo's gold! $B A key you'll need and a key you'll see $B The men you face take blood as fee.
progress: This chest is locked!
completion: Captain Cuergo's hidden treasure awaits!

name: The Sparklematic 5200!
completion: As quickly as it started, the Sparklematic 5200 comes to an abrupt halt. A simple "ding" is heard from the machine, and the mouth of the machine spirals upward. Inside the Sparklematic 5200 is a small box wrapped in a little bow. The machine would appear to wrap an object up after eliminating its grime-encrusted status. Even if the machine didn't work, at least the item is now wrapped in a pretty box. $B Well, there is one way to find out if it cleaned the item or not...

name: More Sparklematic Action
progress:
The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
Grime-Encrusted Object ( 1 )
Required money: 3 ( 1 )
completion: The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro. Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent. $B The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!" The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.

name: Replacement Phial
details: Um... you need another phial of scrying? You're kidding, right? What did you do with the first one?! We have a lot of work ahead of us here, $R . Those phials don't grow on trees! Actually, I wish they did, because I'd go there and pick one off since I don't have another one!! $B in order to make you one, I need the following: a mana potion, a piece of coal, and some sweet nectar. Don't ask why, just bring me what I ask and I'll make you a new one.
progress: To make another phial I need a mana potion, a piece of coal, and some sweet nectar. $B That, and a whole lotta patience apparently.
completion: The mighty adventurer delivers. Hooray for me. By the way, I lied - I had another phial. Ungh, take it. $B Well, what did you expect?! "Oh, here, have another one! I'm just some goofball who has nothing better to do than hand out magical communication devices to adventurers!" Rest assured though, what you have given to me will be enough make you another phial when you lose that too. $B Please prove me wrong and don't lose the new one, okay?

name: Return Trip
completion: I will return you to Sanath's camp now. $B Do not mind his bad manners--he is rude to everyone save for the master. Perhaps he shall learn his lesson one day.

name: Signal for Pickup
completion: Ah, another flare gun, huh? That I can do. $B And don't forget, southern tip of Azshara. It's a small little island that's been turned into a landing pad. You can't miss it if you're in the right spot.

name: One Draenei's Junk...
details: Well, after that display of voracious greed, I feel nauseous. $B Regardless, I shall not dwell too long on your material addiction. $B For each imperfect draenethyst fragment you turn in, I shall reward you with more junk. My junk heap gets smaller while your junk heap gets larger. On Draenor we call this a 'win-win' situation.
progress: Well? Draenethyst? Remember? $B Is anybody home?
completion: You truly disgust me, $R . A grown man drooling over a pile of junk? Pitiful! Take your reward and get out of my sight. $B Sounds familiar? It should, because I say it a thousand times per day. $B Oh how I loathe this world.

name: Meeting with the Master
completion: There was a time when I could ask whatever I wished from those who sought out my master. But now, you need only ask and I will send you to him. $B It is upsetting to me, but I do not question his orders. I can only take enjoyment in making fun of the ridiculous clothes you wear or the pathetic look on your face. Even that bores me... $B Even this rambling bores me! Do you wish to see my master or not?

name: To the Top
completion: Would you like to see the view atop one of the twin colossals? I can send you there, $R . $B Do consider how you will get down, though. This is a one way trip only.

name: Seeping Corruption
completion: I never dreamed the elixir would take hold that quickly. Thank you, $N . I will get to work on the rest of these samples right away. I'm sure they'll be usable by the Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken soon enough.

name: An OOX of Your Own
completion: You've recovered three of my OOX homing robots! You've gone above and beyond what you needed to, so I will give you something special for all your help. It is a miniature version of the very same robot that you have come to know and love, the OOX! $B I normally wouldn't let anyone have such a potentially lethal device, but you've been a real help. Besides - the combat mechanisms and the homing logic on this one have been disabled. $B Other than that, it's an OOX by golly!

name: Morrowgrain to Feathermoon Stronghold
progress:
Hello again, $N . My research is progressing fairly well, but if you have five more Morrowgrain I'd be happy to take them off your hands. Well... happy is a figurative term in this case; the more I am around them, the more uncomfortable I feel. Still, my research demands I buckle down and get through this.
Morrowgrain ( 5 )
completion: Thanks $N ; I'll just store these out of the way for the time being. While I don't command the resources that Staghelm does, I am able to give you a little something for your trouble. Anyway, who knows what will happen if Staghelm keeps getting Morrowgrain after Morrowgrain. There's something fishy going on, mark my words. $B Remember that I'm always looking for more Morrowgrain. I'll take them in quantities of five at a time.

name: Morrowgrain to Darnassus
progress:
The Arch Druid is always looking for additional morrowgrain for the Cenarion Circle's continued research. We take them in increments of ten, and award you with a cache of goods you should find useful. When you have ten, let me know and I will reward you accordingly.
Morrowgrain ( 10 )
completion: Excellent - this morrowgrain will no doubt please the Arch Druid. I must admit though... just being near them makes me feel a little uncomfortable. I can only imagine how difficult it is for the Arch Druid to tolerate them in such large numbers! $B This is for you, $N . The Cenarion Circle thanks you for your continued support.

name: Morrowgrain to Thunder Bluff
progress:
The Arch Druid is always looking for more morrowgrain for the Cenarion Circle's research project on Un'Goro Crater. We take them in increments of ten, and award you with a cache of goods you should find useful. When you have ten, let me know and I will award you accordingly.
Morrowgrain ( 10 )
completion: Excellent - this morrowgrain will no doubt help when the time comes. We know that the night elves are conducting similar research into these herbs, though it isn't clear to what end they will use them for if they discover anything. The Arch Druid thinks that the need for morrowgrain will remain until we've figured out the mysteries behind this herb. $B This is for you, $N . The Cenarion Circle thanks you for your continued support.

name: CLUCK!
details: "Cluck... cluck... cluck... BACAW! $B Cluck... cluck... cluck." $B The chicken looks up at you and then starts to scratch its claws into the ground. You think it is spelling out a word, but you are not sure what it is. Could it be... S-A-L-D-E-A-N? Before you can ask, the chicken turns away and goes about its business.
progress: The chicken stares at you with dark, cold eyes. It waits for you hungrily. $B "BACAAAW! $B Cluck...cluck...cluck."
completion: "BACAW!!!" $B The chicken starts to gobble up the feed you put down. $B After a moment, the chicken looks around, startled. It uncomfortably shuffles back and forth. Is this chicken pregnant? You think you better check underneath it.

name: The Videre Elixir
progress:
Bring me an Evoroot, and sure, I can make ya that Videre Elixir. $B I know all kinds of things about herbs and alchemy... Why, let me tell you the story about the time I transmuted gold from the cheese I was going to eat for lunch... hey... Where are you going?
Evoroot ( 1 )
completion: So, you pulled a fast one on ol' Miblon, eh?

name: The Spectral Chalice
progress:
The spectral chalice floats in the air, slowing rising and falling... as if to the beat of a dying heart.
Star Ruby ( 2 )
Gold Bar ( 20 )
Truesilver Bar ( 10 )
completion: The gems make no sound as they fall into depths of the chalice...

name: Salve via Hunting
progress:
Possessing a Cenarion beacon allows one to see a corrupted soul shard on those tainted beasts that are put down for the greater good. I grind shards into a usable reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. We will use that salve to turn corrupted plants into healthy ones again. $B In exchange for these shards, I will give you some Cenarion plant salves I have already prepared.
Corrupted Soul Shard ( 6 )
completion: Very well then, here are your Cenarion plant salves. Scour Felwood for corrupted plants, $N ! Wherever they are, use the salve I have given you to purify them.

name: Salve via Mining
progress:
If you possess a Cenarion beacon while mining in Felwood, you will be able to see tainted vitriol that corrupts a vein of raw metal. I know how to purify that vitriol and turn it into a reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. You will then use that salve on plants you find in the wild that need saving. $B If you have collected any tainted vitriol, I'll give you some Cenarion plant salve I have already prepared.
Tainted Vitriol ( 4 )
completion: Very well then, here's some Cenarion plant salve. If you find more vitriol when you mine in Felwood, remember to hold on to it for me! The more of it you find, the more salve I will be able to make.

name: Salve via Gathering
progress:
A Cenarion beacon allows a seasoned herbalist to spot insidious fel creep - a malfeasant product of Felwood's corruption. My work here has taught me the knowledge of purifying fel creep into a cleansing reagent... used in what we now refer to as Cenarion plant salve. $B When you gather herbs in Felwood, you should encounter the fel creep so long as you have the beacon. In exchange for what you bring to me, I will give you pre-made Cenarion plant salve.
Fel Creep ( 4 )
completion: Excellent work $N - every bit of this, once we purify it, will help us take back Felwood. Here, take some doses of Cenarion plant salve and head into the forest. The reclaiming of the land from the corruption waits for no $R !

name: Salve via Skinning
progress:
A Cenarion beacon will allow a well-trained skinner to spot patches of tainted skin from bounty gathered in Felwood. I convert these seemingly useless patches into a thick paste that serves as a quickening agent for Cenarion plant salve. When you skin your kills here in Felwood, be sure to have a beacon on you! $B When you collect tainted patches, bring them to me and I will give you some Cenarion plant salves that I have already made.
Patch of Tainted Skin ( 5 )
completion: This is exactly what I need. Here - take these plant salves and use them to reclaim Felwood from the corruption. We must persevere, $N !

name: Salve via Disenchanting
progress:
The power of a disenchanted magical item is felt by the essence it creates. I've devised a way to turn raw essence used by enchanters into a suitable reagent for creating Cenarion plant salve. You don't need a Cenarion beacon for this; any suitably disenchanted item that yields lesser nether essences will work. $B I just need a single lesser nether essence; in exchange, I will give you Cenarion plant salves. The essence is extremely potent - a little definitely goes a long way!
Lesser Nether Essence ( 1 )
completion: Here are some Cenarion plant salves - I only need one lesser nether essence for this, $N . Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. If you need more salve, then find me here!

name: Bloodpetal Sprouts
progress:
Here's the plan, $N : Go out and collect some bloodpetal sprouts -- you know, the plants that haven't fully sprouted yet, and bring them here. Then I'll see what the Atal'ai haze can do. $B You may think I'm vengeful... Actually, you'd be right about that! $B Truth is, I know the way out of here, but until Larion will admit that I'm right, I'm staying right here! $B So off with you, find those bloodpetal sprouts and let's have some fun!
Bloodpetal Sprout ( 3 )
completion: Here goes nothing, $N ! This will get Larion's attention!

name: Bloodpetal Zapper
progress:

But until then, I'll just have to show him that his little prank doesn't bother me at all!

name: The Tome of Nobility
details: Hello, $N . I see your dedication remains strong, as does your faith. $B I think it is time you spoke with Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. There are some more lessons for you to learn, and I feel you are prepared. $B Seek him out in the Cathedral of Light, and $N , take these lessons seriously. You've attained your status through humility and hard work, do not disappoint us by becoming arrogant. $B Be well.
completion: Ah, you've returned to the Cathedral, $N . Good. A lot has happened recently, and I would seek your aid if you prove worthy. $B Many treacherous enemies are about. I will need your help to stop them.

name: The Tome of Nobility
details: Well, well, well, look at the mighty paladin in all regality. $B Sorry, $N , I meant no offense... I just get a little jealous sometimes when I see some of the feats you've accomplished. Tiza tells me it's my weakness, and I swore to her I'd work on it. It's just hard sometimes, you know? $B But the reason I wanted to talk to you was because Duthorian Rall in Stormwind sent word for you to meet him in the Cathedral of Light when you're ready. Sounded important. Sounded like something's going on.
completion: Ah, you've returned to the Cathedral, $N . Good. A lot has happened recently, and I would seek your aid if you prove worthy. $B Many treacherous enemies are about. I will need your help to stop them.

name: Summon Felsteed
details: Ah, good, you're here. I sent a after you to get your attention, but it seems you were able to get here before it found you. No matter. $B There has been some talk lately of your growing power--that is good for you, possibly bad for others. But those are irrelevant points. The point is, I feel you've proven yourself and therefore are deserving of... hehe... a blessing of sorts. $B Above Ratchet in the Barrens you'll find a man named Strahad. I believe you've crossed paths before.
completion: So, you've decided to grace my presence again. How kind of you. $B My acolytes wondered if you'd ever show up. I told them there was no doubt. When power is concerned, you are drawn in like a moth to the flame.

name: Summon Felsteed
details: Ah, $N , you've seen fit to grace us with your presence. How wonderful! $B I hope you do not expect us to wait on you hand and foot also. You may be growing quickly in power, but you still are a pup when it comes to true knowledge and understanding. If you're not careful, corruption will overwhelm you and your weak will. $B But I should get to the point: Strahad wishes to speak to you. He is still residing in his tower overlooking Ratchet in the Barrens. I suggest not taking too long.
completion: So, you've decided to grace my presence again. How kind of you. $B My acolytes wondered if you'd ever show up. I told them there was no doubt. When power is concerned, you are drawn in like a moth to the flame.

name: Testing for Impurities - Un'Goro Crater
progress:
You take a sample of slime from Un'Goro Crater and place some of it into the various tubes and beakers on the table. As things begin to boil and spurt, the slime changes colors. When the process slows down and the liquids calm, you see a small petri dish with your purified Un'Goro slime samples in it along with some other remnants.
Un'Goro Slime Sample ( 1 )
completion: You pick up the petri dish with the slime sample in it. The only way to discern if the samples is pure enough is to open it and examine the contents yourself. Ideally you'll find a sample that fits Chemist Fuely's criteria.

name: Frostsaber Provisions
details: If you wish to prove yourself, you may begin by doing a very simple, but very important task. $B Gather meat from the chimaera and from the shardtooth bears in the area. Bring it to me so that I may use it to feed the frostsabers that are being trained.
progress: Discipline and determination are your goals. I may ask you to do a simple task many times; you must perform to the best of your ability each time.
completion: Thank you for assisting me, $N . My opinion of you grows as time passes.

name: Counting Out Time
details: If you are willing to help once more, I can certainly use your assistance. I'll gladly take more watches you might uncover from the ruins of Andorhal. They certainly help me in maintaining a balance against whatever malign force is meddling with the timeline here. $B In exchange for those watches, I'll give you another item that, in the future, I suspect you'll find quite the use for.
progress: The watches of Andorhal, much like the large clock on the ruins of the town hall, all are frozen in time at three o'clock. This was when the full effects of the plague first spread out over the city, choking the life out of it. $B As much as we all may regret what happened that day, it has shaped the flow of time as you mortals perceive it. The bronze dragonflight must persevere in protecting the timeline!
completion: Again, I think you for your assistance. Please accept this gift. While you still may not know when to use such an item, perhaps in the future the path of time will reveal its true intentions to you. You could say that I've seen as such happening to you, $N .

name: Agamaggan's Strength
progress:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $R . $B Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. $B The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
Blood Shard ( 4 )
completion: If only Mangletooth were free to see you decimate those who betrayed him! $B I thank you for destroying more of the Bristleback by gathering these shards. Please, continue to do so, and I will continue to aid you.

name: Agamaggan's Agility
progress:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue could measure up to their quickness in battle. $B Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
Blood Shard ( 4 )
completion: May your aim be unerring, and the mark of your weapon be true, $R . $B Agamaggan's spirit is with you. Return to me if you wish. Mangletooth will bless you again if the great boar god deems me worthy.

name: Wisdom of Agamaggan
progress:
The shaman and geomancers of the quilboar tribes call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, $R . $B If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you.
Blood Shard ( 4 )
completion: Your enemies should fear you even more, $R . $B Tell Mangletooth tales of your cunning in battle when next we meet--be it in this life, or the next.

name: Rising Spirit
progress:
Warriors of all types have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess in battle. $B Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle.
Blood Shard ( 4 )
completion: Our greatest warriors, and our greatest shamans would envy your will, $R . $B Defeat more of the Bristlebacks knowing that they cannot stop you!

name: Razorhide
progress:
All those who enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war. $B Bring me 4 blood shards and I will grant you the same protection.
Blood Shard ( 4 )
completion: Go to war, $R .

name: Mrs. Dalson's Diary
completion: A diary with yellowing pages lies open to the last entry: $B "I don't know what's going to happen now that Harold's turned. It took everything out of me to drag him into the only place I could find that'd lock him up tight and hold him. I hid the key on me, and I pray it works... $B I hope I can get out of here, but I need money to do that. Our stuff's all in the cabinet I think... and now that I think about it, doesn't Harold keep the key on him? $B I'll rest on it, I'm dead tired now."

name: Locked Away
progress:
The door to the outhouse has begun to splinter at the edges of the frame as though it has been repeatedly and incessantly tried to be forced open. It is currently locked up tight from the outside of the outhouse. $B As you rattle the door, you hear a guttural moaning come from inside! Whatever is inside there, it certainly does not sound friendly.
Dalson Outhouse Key ( 1 )
completion: Using the key found on the skeleton of the former Mrs. Dalson, you unlock the door to the outhouse. A bloodthirsty ghoul leaps from the outhouse, having been trapped inside for who knows how long. $B It is clear by the bloodcurdling scream of the ghoul at your presence that the former Farmer Dalson is now beyond saving.

name: Locked Away
progress:
An extremely sturdy cabinet stands before you, securely fastened shut by a built-in lock. The front of the cabinet is deeply scratched and marked. This could be surmised as being from numerous and violent failed attempts to reveal whatever secrets the cabinet currently obfuscates from view. $B If you are going to open this cabinet, you will need to find the key.
Dalson Cabinet Key ( 1 )
completion: The key taken from Farmer Dalson's ghoulish remains fits the lock perfectly. The doors of the cabinet swing open, revealing several items that remain intact and appear quite valuable.

name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
details: A finer cap you may never see. From the pristine hide of the beast, our expert crafters will create the most phenomenal hat a prestidigitator could ever hope to don! $B Fifty gold pieces along with the listed items and your head shall be graced with the Cap of the Scarlet Savant: $B *The pristine hide of the beast. $B *Frayed abomination stitchings. $B *Arcane crystals. $B *Enchanted scarlet thread. $B BEHOLD!
progress: Unless you've got everything I need, you're wasting my time.
completion: Astounding! It must have taken weeks to gather those components... and how did you find a pristine hide?!? $B Enjoy the cap, $N !

name: Leggings of Arcana
details: While the crafting of such an item has never successfully been accomplished, it is thought to be possible - under the right circumstance. $B Should the seeker of arcanum desire to imbue leggings with immense power, the following they must find: $B * The pristine hide of the Beast. $B * Frayed abomination stitchings. $B *Arcanite Bars. $B *Frostwhisper's embalming fluid. $B BEHOLD!

name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
details: It is said that only one Breastplate of Bloodthirst has ever been created and that it was made for the legendary assassin, Garona. Whether this world will ever see another is doubtful. $B Regardless! Our master crafters can reproduce the item given the necessary components: $B *The pristine hide of the Beast. $B *Frayed abomination stitchings. $B *Arcanite bars. $B *The skin of shadow. $B BEHOLD!
progress: Unless you've got everything I need, you're wasting my time.
completion: I thought I would be dead and buried before I ever saw this day. $B An accomplishment of this magnitude can only be overshadowed by the reward.

name: The Medallion of Faith
progress:
The power of this chapel gives me the strength to resist the corruption in my heart. If I leave it, I will become a death knight. But there is a medallion, the medallion of faith, that will give me the strength I need to leave. $B Please, $N , retrieve the medallion. It is guarded by Malor the Zealous, a crazed member of the Scarlet Brotherhood who resides deep in the Scarlet Bastion in western Stratholme.
Medallion of Faith ( 1 )
completion: You retrieved the medallion! Now I will be able to leave the chapel and perform my duty. $B That duty is to kill the beast who helped corrupt me and so many of my brothers and sisters, Baron Rivendare!

name: Aurius' Reckoning
completion: $N , I am dying... but my soul is saved. For that, I owe you more than words can say. Please, take this... and fight on, brave $C !

name: Lorax's Tale
details: The Satyr paces about and talks to himself. Do you wish to question him?
completion: <Lorax laughs.>

name: Dadanga is Hungry!
progress:
Dadanga looks up at you as you approach her. She seems to be hoping for something... $B She's probably hungry! $B There's got to be something growing in the crater that would be just the perfect snack for a large herbivore. Dadanga's a big girl; whatever you bring her, there would need to be a lot of it!
Bloodpetal Sprout ( 15 )
completion: Placing the sprouts in front of her, Dadanga seems pleased. $B She nudges a small brown-wrapped package towards you, in exchange for the treat!

name: Winterfall Intrusion
details: My presence goes unnoticed by most, $N . However, there is an annoyance that seems firmly rooted here in Winterspring: the Winterfall furbolg. $B Although I have never directly attacked the furbolg, they seem crazed, fearful of anything in their path. I have watched them slay countless creatures that had the misfortune to simply be in the wrong place at the wrong time. $B I am weary of their meddling -- please, help me by fighting back. Slay the furbolg and keep them away from Frostsaber Rock.
progress: The furbolgs seem to suffer from such paranoia...
completion: I am relieved to hear that for a short moment, we will not have to worry about the Winterfall intrusion. $B You are beginning to show your perseverance, $N .

name: Mission Accomplished!
completion: $N , your successful re-engineering of the cauldrons is a tremendous victory for us! $B Let all within my presence hear: for service to the Forsaken and to the Horde as a whole above and beyond what was expected - in the face of overwhelming odds and incredible danger, might I add - I give $N this, and I extend upon him our undying gratitude as a true hero of the Horde. Huzzah!

name: Argent Dawn Commission
completion: All who fight evil on behalf of the Argent Dawn must don our commission. Wearing such will earn your right to claim rewards our quartermasters have to offer. $B While under commission, you'll be able to acquire Scourgestones from slain Scourge; these are marks of insignia that they sometimes possess. Procure these insignia and bring them to me. For each set you turn in, you will receive our marker of heroism - the Argent Dawn Valor Token. $B Achieve your destiny, $C - join the fight today!

name: Minion's Scourgestones
progress:
A Minion's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge rank and file. These are sometimes found on the weaker of their troops positioned in the Plaguelands, though the term "weaker" is certainly to be considered in context. The Scourge, no matter where they are, should never be underestimated. $B The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for twenty of these insignia - an exchange I'm happy to do, provided you have earned enough scourgestones!
Minion's Scourgestone ( 20 )
completion: Congratulations, $N - I am pleased to award you with an Argent Dawn valor token! $B The tokens serve two purposes. One - they can be used to further your standing within the Argent Dawn; to do so may avail you options and rewards that are reserved for our honored and revered allies. Two - they can be given to our quartermasters, along with coin, as payment for some of the Dawn's more prized items. $B Whatever you decide, know that you are earning your commission. Well done!

name: Invader's Scourgestones
progress:
An Invader's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's elite troops. These are sometimes found on the stronger of the troops positioned in the Plaguelands. Slaying such a creature is indeed a challenge, but one that should be relished with a commission to vanquish evil. $B The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for ten of these insignia. Bring them to me here, and I will make sure you receive your just reward.
Invader's Scourgestone ( 10 )
completion: Congratulations, $N - I am pleased to award you with an Argent Dawn valor token! $B Each valor token handed out to worthy recipients is a sign of the tide turning against the Scourge. With more and more heroes fighting the Scourge in their own lands, the Argent Dawn will assuredly be at the forefront when the time comes to wage war on the ultimate evil of the Scourge. I hope that the valor you've shown what it took to acquiring your token will carry the day then as well!

name: Corruptor's Scourgestones
progress:
A Corruptor's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's overlords. A powerful being that holds a position of authority over the Scourge will always possess one. To slay such a malevolent creature would surely advance the cause of the Argent Dawn, and all good causes! $B On behalf of the Argent Dawn, I will give you a valor token in exchange for just a single one these insignia. Use caution in acquiring one, $N - such powerful beings are not to be trifled with.
Corruptor's Scourgestone ( 1 )
completion: Congratulations, $N - I am pleased to award you with an Argent Dawn valor token! $B To acquire a valor token in such a manner indicates that you are a true hero in the cause of good. We value all effort brought to bear against the Scourge, but to take down one of their leaders is to truly deliver onto them a crushing defeat! $B For the Dawn, my brother!

progress:

If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... get my drift mon? For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish!
Shellfish ( 5 )
completion: Sweet mon, nothing beats work being done, especially if it's someone else doing the work... eh?

name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
progress:
Need another suit, do ya? Well, I'm not going anywhere soon it seems - bring me the same things I asked for from before, and I'll make you another ogre suit.
Bolt of Runecloth ( 4 )
Rugged Leather ( 8 )
Rune Thread ( 2 )
Ogre Tannin ( 1 )
completion: Here ya go $N - put this thing on, and you'll have ten minutes to do whatever. Good luck! $B Oh, and if you happen to find a key to get me out of here, BY ALL MEANS LET ME KNOW!!!

name: Free Knot!
progress:
It's called the Gordok Shackle Key - well, that's what these "tons o' fun" keep calling it. I think any of the ogres might have it, but I'm not sure if any specific ones do. Maybe the guards have a better chance of having one... $B What am I talking about - you have it already, don't you?! Is that it there??!
Gordok Shackle Key ( 1 )
completion: You - ranked number one. Everyone else - ranked number two or lower. Oh, thank you for freeing me! $B I knew my life was destined for more than just being an appetizer to some ogre!

name: The Gordok Taste Test
completion: You da big boss now, so you get free sample of my better brews! These drinks boost you up AND give you good buzz! These are da good ones, chief... you try and tell Kreeg yourself!

name: Healthy Dragon Scale
details: This is a scale shed from a plagued dragon hatchling. But unlike the other pocked, oozing scales on the infant beast, this rare scale is healthy and unmarred. $B Betina Bigglezink will want a sample of this to study.
progress: $N , do you have something to show me?
completion: Excellent! This will be invaluable in my continued studies of the machinations of the Scourge. Thank you, $N , and if you find more of these scales please bring them to me!

name: Stars of Elune
completion: You've proven yourself worthy of Elune's attention, $N . If you feel you're ready, I would very much like to teach you one of her spells unique to our people.

name: Desperate Prayer
details: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $N . $B About this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also. $B When your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.
completion: I'm glad you've arrived, $N . There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light. $B There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

name: Salve via Hunting
progress:
Possessing a Cenarion beacon allows one to see a corrupted soul shard on those tainted beasts that are put down for the greater good. I grind shards into a usable reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. We will use that salve to turn corrupted plants into healthy ones again. $B In exchange for these shards, I will give you some Cenarion plant salves I have already prepared.
Corrupted Soul Shard ( 6 )
completion: Very well then, here are your Cenarion plant salves. Scour Felwood for corrupted plants, $N ! Wherever they are, use the salve I have given you to purify them.

name: Salve via Mining
progress:
If you possess a Cenarion beacon while mining in Felwood, you will be able to see tainted vitriol that corrupts a vein of raw metal. I know how to purify that vitriol and turn it into a reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. You will then use that salve on plants you find in the wild that need saving. $B If you have collected any tainted vitriol, I'll give you some Cenarion plant salve I have already prepared.
Tainted Vitriol ( 4 )
completion: Very well then, here's some Cenarion plant salve. If you find more vitriol when you mine in Felwood, remember to hold on to it for me! The more of it you find, the more salve I will be able to make.

name: Salve via Gathering
progress:
A Cenarion beacon allows a seasoned herbalist to spot insidious fel creep - a malfeasant product of Felwood's corruption. My work here has taught me the knowledge of purifying fel creep into a cleansing reagent... used in what we now refer to as Cenarion plant salve. $B When you gather herbs in Felwood, you should encounter the fel creep so long as you have the beacon. In exchange for what you bring to me, I will give you pre-made Cenarion plant salve.
Fel Creep ( 4 )
completion: Excellent work $N - every bit of this, once we purify it, will help us take back Felwood. Here, take some doses of Cenarion plant salve and head into the forest. The reclaiming of the land from the corruption waits for no $R !

name: Salve via Skinning
progress:
A Cenarion beacon will allow a well-trained skinner to spot patches of tainted skin from bounty gathered in Felwood. I convert these seemingly useless patches into a thick paste that serves as a quickening agent for Cenarion plant salve. When you skin your kills here in Felwood, be sure to have a beacon on you! $B When you collect tainted patches, bring them to me and I will give you some Cenarion plant salves that I have already made.
Patch of Tainted Skin ( 5 )
completion: This is exactly what I need. Here - take these plant salves and use them to reclaim Felwood from the corruption. We must persevere, $N !

name: Salve via Disenchanting
progress:
The power of a disenchanted magical item is felt by the essence it creates. I've devised a way to turn raw essence used by enchanters into a suitable reagent for creating Cenarion plant salve. You don't need a Cenarion beacon for this; any suitably disenchanted item that yields lesser nether essences will work. $B I just need a single lesser nether essence; in exchange, I will give you Cenarion plant salves. The essence is extremely potent - a little definitely goes a long way!
Lesser Nether Essence ( 1 )
completion: Here are some Cenarion plant salves - I only need one lesser nether essence for this, $N . Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. If you need more salve, then find me here!
