name: Irondeep Supplies
details: Before the fighting started, we stored supplies for Dun Baldar in the Irondeep mine. The troggs that surfaced there weren't much of a problem when we had spare troops to guard the mine, but now that we're fighting with the Horde we can't maintain control of Irondeep. $B We need the supplies in Irondeep, $N . Enter the mine and bring me a load of them.
progress: Do you have the supplies, $N ? We can never have enough!
completion: Well done! I'll put these supplies to good use! Thanks, $N !

name: Coldtooth Supplies
details: The Coldtooth mine to the north was once an ideal place to store extra supplies, but now that the fighting with the Stormpikes grows fierce, we do not always have the spare warriors to station at the mine and protect it. And so, control of the mine often falls to the Alliance, or to underground denizens... $B But we still need our supplies, $N ! Go to the Coldtooth mine and bring me a load of them. And be wary of enemies as you go; the tides of battle shift quickly in that place...
progress: Have you been to the Coldtooth mine, $N ? Do you have the supplies I asked for?
completion: Ah, you got them. Good work, $N ! These supplies are a little musty from sitting in that dark mine for so long, but we'll make use of them nonetheless. $B Thank you, $N . Your deeds are vital to the maintenance of our fighting forces.

name: Rampaging Giants
details: Around 4,000 years ago, Tyrande Whisperwind saved the life of the frostsaber queen, at the hands of rampaging giants. Since then, the frostsabers have been allies of the night elves. $B These same giants that once were a danger to the frostsabers, still exist not too far from here. They are called the frostmaul, and they have taken over the large valley to the south. $B Prove your loyalty to the frostsabers; kill these giants in the name of the frostsaber queen, Shy-Rotam!
completion: Excellent, $N . Your determination has been duly noted.

name: The Ashenvale Hunt
completion: There are three legendary creatures that make up the Ashenvale Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might. In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself. The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon. $B The creatures of the Ashenvale Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down. If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.

name: Warsong Runner Update
progress:
So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will. $B You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, $N . I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here. $B But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.
Warsong Report ( 1 )
completion: Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. You must return this to him as quickly as possible.

name: Warsong Outrider Update
progress:
Much danger lies along this path, $N . You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. The threat of the alliance is quite near. $B We are faced by enemies on all fronts. The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale. I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara. $B It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, $N .
Warsong Report ( 1 )
completion: Take my update to Kadrak. Swiftly, $N .

name: Warsong Scout Update
progress:
Keep an eye out, $R . The elves are often hiding in the shadows... $B We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us. $B I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?
Warsong Report ( 1 )
completion: Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. Our plans are going well.

name: Warsong Saw Blades
progress:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here. $B ..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap! $B What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making. $B So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
Deadly Blunderbuss ( 1 )
completion: This is perfect -- just the thing! Well, here's the shipment.

name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Dark Iron Ore
progress:
Dark Iron, while plentiful in the Depths, is still a valued commodity amongst the Brotherhood. The sacred arms and armaments of Ragnaros favor Dark Iron. $B For every 10 pieces of Dark Iron Ore you offer, favor amongst the Brotherhood you will gain.
Dark Iron Ore ( 10 )
completion: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.

name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Fiery Core
progress:
Woe unto those that tempt fate inside the Molten Core. Death comes swiftly - the punishment dealt without mercy. $B Many of the Brotherhood have been lost in their search for Fiery Cores. $B Offer 1 Fiery Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.
Fiery Core ( 1 )
completion: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.

name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core
progress:
The Thorium Brotherhood sympathizes with your plight, $R . This is why Lokthos has been empowered to bargain. $B Offer 1 Lava Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.
Lava Core ( 1 )
completion: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.

name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Core Leather
progress:
Many of the sacred recipes require the skin from Ragnaros' chosen pets. $B Offer 2 Core Leather, skinned from the smoldering corpses of the Core Hounds of the Molten Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.
Core Leather ( 2 )
completion: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.

name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Blood of the Mountain
progress:
The tears of the Fire Lord are a rare find indeed. $B Offer 1 Blood of the Mountain and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.
Blood of the Mountain ( 1 )
completion: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.

name: Syndicate Emblems
progress:
We have been entrenched in a battle with the Syndicate for years. What they lack in skill they make up for in numbers. It's impossible to kill them off fast enough to have any noticeable impact on their population! $B We've found that the best way to deal with their size is to pilfer their emblems. Once an emblem is stolen the shamed member is 'dealt' with internally. $B Pick their pockets clean and turn the emblems in to me or one of the other guards. $B Start at Durnholde, south of here.
Syndicate Emblem ( 1 )
completion: Hey, nice work! Keep this up and the other rogues might stop spitting on you.

name: More Booty!
progress:
I need more armor scraps, $N ! Do you have any?
Armor Scraps ( 20 )
completion: Thanks again, $N . You do the Horde proud...

name: More Armor Scraps
progress:
$N , we need more armor scraps to supply our troops!
Armor Scraps ( 20 )
completion: These are some good pieces, $N . I can use them to fashion new equipment for our troops. $B If my supply level gets high enough, then maybe our seasoned fighting units will enter the field!

name: Lokholar the Ice Lord
progress:
I come from Thunder Bluff, $R . Cairne himself has seen to it that I assist the Frostwolf Clan in these dire times. $B But let us not waste any more time. You must strike down our enemies and bring to me their blood. Once enough blood has been gathered, the ritual of summoning may begin. $B Victory will be assured when the elemental lord is loosed upon the Stormpike army.
Stormpike Soldier's Blood ( 1 )
completion: The blood of our enemies has been shed. I shall mix this blood with the rest that has been gathered. Once the offering is complete, the Ice Lord shall show these Stormpike dogs the full wrath of the Frostwolf Clan!

name: Call of Air - Guse's Fleet
progress:
We must prepare the new fleet of War Riders, $R ! My riders are set to make a strike on the central battlefield; but first, I must wet their appetites - preparing them for the assault. $B I need enough Stormpike Soldier Flesh to feed a fleet! Hundreds of pounds! Surely you can handle that, yes? Get going!
Stormpike Soldier's Flesh ( 1 )
completion: The fleet feeds on their flesh. It consumes the enemy. $B Flight is imminent!

name: Call of Air - Jeztor's Fleet
progress:
You've worked hard, $N , but we have only just begun! $B My War Riders must taste in the flesh of their targets. This will ensure a surgical strike against our enemies! $B My fleet is the second most powerful in our air command. Thusly, they will strike at the more powerful of our adversaries. For this, then, they need the flesh of the Stormpike Lieutenants. $B Make haste, soldier!
Stormpike Lieutenant's Flesh ( 1 )
completion: More! More! Bring more for they are soon to be ready!

name: Call of Air - Mulverick's Fleet
progress:
I was locked up in a dwarven hellhole for days. You better believe I want revenge! $B We must plan carefully. $B First, my war riders need targets to gun for - high priority targets. I'm going to need to feed them the flesh of Stormpike Commanders. Unfortunately, those little buggers are entrenched deep behind enemy lines! You've definitely got your work cut out for you.
Stormpike Commander's Flesh ( 1 )
completion: Not enough! I would expect this level of work from an initiate, but you, $N ? Come on, soldier! HUSTLE! More flesh is needed!

name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
details: Your war in the heart of Alterac means nothing to the Syndicate, $C . We will do as we have always done: Wait until a clear victor rises from the ashes and rubble of this madness and then strike. $B That, however, is not why we are here now. The All Seeing Eye has been lost - taken by the Winterax trolls of the region. $B Recover the Eye and our services shall be yours - for whatever time remains for your side. $B Return to me once you acquire the eye so that I may examine you. $B

name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
details: Your war in the heart of Alterac means nothing to the Syndicate, $C . We will do as we have always done: Wait until a clear victor rises from the ashes and rubble of this madness and then strike. $B That, however, is not why we are here now. The All Seeing Eye has been lost - taken by the Winterax trolls of the region. $B Recover the Eye and our services shall be yours - for whatever time remains for your side. $B Return to me once you acquire the eye so that I may examine you. $B

name: Zinfizzlex's Portable Shredder Unit
details: I'm as anxious as you are to try out my portable shredder unit, $R , but before I can make the kit, I'm going to need materials - lots of materials! $B To be exact, I'm going to need a mountain of thorium, mithril, and iron. I will also need one steamsaw per unit. You'll have to get those at the lumber mill. $B When I was nosing around in here (before my capture) I noticed a pile of steamsaws at the Stormpike lumber camp.

name: Zinfizzlex's Portable Shredder Unit
details: I'm as anxious as you are to try out my portable shredder unit, $R , but before I can make the kit, I'm going to need materials - lots of materials! $B To be exact, I'm going to need a mountain of thorium, mithril, and iron. I will also need one steamsaw per unit. You'll have to get those at the lumber mill. $B When I was nosing around in here (before my capture) I noticed a pile of steamsaws at the Frostwolf lumber camp.

name: Ivus the Forest Lord
progress:
The Frostwolf Clan is protected by a taint of elemental energy. Their shaman meddle in powers that will surely destroy us all if left unchecked. $B The damage has grown too great for the Circle to control! Ivus must be called to our aid. $B The Frostwolf soldiers carry elemental charms called storm crystals. We can use the charms to conjure Ivus. Venture forth and claim the crystals, $N !
Storm Crystal ( 1 )
completion: Well done, $N . I will use the power of this charm to augment the magic that has already been gathered. When enough power has been amassed, I shall focus the collected energies and call upon the Forest Lord to aid our cause.

name: Call of Air - Vipore's Fleet
progress:
The elite Frostwolf units that guard the lines must be dealt with, soldier! I'm tasking you with thinning out that herd of savages. Return to me with medals from their lieutenants and legionnaires. When I feel that enough of the riff-raff has been dealt with, I'll deploy the air strike.
Frostwolf Lieutenant's Medal ( 1 )
completion: The flight will be ready soon. Continue your efforts!

name: Call of Air - Slidore's Fleet
progress:
My gryphons are poised to strike at the front lines but cannot make the attack until the lines are thinned out. $B The Frostwolf warriors charged with holding the front lines wear medals of service proudly upon their chests. Rip those medals off their rotten corpses and bring them back here. $B Once the front line is sufficiently thinned out, I will make the call to air! Death from above!
Frostwolf Soldier's Medal ( 1 )
completion: Keep em coming, soldier! The Aerie gryphons will be ready to strike in no time at all!

name: Call of Air - Ichman's Fleet
progress:
Their spirits are low, soldier. After our last failed air strike against the Horde, they refuse to fly! It is up to you to bolster their morale. $B Return to the battlefield and strike at the heart of the Frostwolf's command. Take down their commanders and guardians. Return to me with as many of their medals as you can stuff in your pack! I promise you, when my gryphons see the bounty and smell the blood of our enemies, they will fly again! Go now!
Frostwolf Commander's Medal ( 1 )
completion: Can you see it? Look at them, soldier! They're coming around... Soon, Ichman's flight will once again strike at the heart of the valley! Stormpike will rule the skies!

name: Coldtooth Supplies
details: The Coldtooth mine is a storage depot for the Horde. I can't stomach the food they give their troops, and the state of their arms and armor is atrocious! But... in times like these when supplies are so important, we can use what they have. $B Enter the Coldtooth mine and bring me back their supplies. That will help keep the Alliance in fighting shape, and remove much needed equipment from the Horde's warriors. $B Good luck, $N . The mine is to the distant south, deep in Horde territory.
progress: Did you enter the Coldtooth mine in Horde territory, $N ? Did you raid their supplies?
completion: You got them! Well done, $N ! I'll go through these supplies and get them ready for our own troops!

name: Irondeep Supplies
details: The Stormpike dwarves are using the Irondeep mine as a storage depot. I want you to raid that mine and bring me its supplies. This will curtail the Stormpikes' efforts in Alterac Valley, and will provide us with needed equipment! $B Be wary, $N . The Irondeep mine is deep in Alliance territory, and control of the mine is as shifting as the snows of Alterac.
progress: Did you enter the Irondeep mine, $N ? Did you raid its supplies?
completion: You got them! Nicely done, $N ! And I hope you saw a few dwarves during your raid, and shed their blood for the Frostwolves!

name: Empty Stables
details: The war in the valley has taken its toll on our soldiers. We must revitalize our forces! $B If we can fill up the stables, the Wolf Riders will once more be able to ride out into the field of battle. $B Take this muzzle and track down the frostwolves that inhabit the nearby forest. Once you find a wolf, use the muzzle to tame the beast. Bring the tamed beast back to me so that I may place it in the stable. $B When we have enough wolves stabled, the Wolf Riders will rejoin their patrol on our front lines.
progress: Without your help, the Frostwolf Wolf Riders would not have mounts to ride into battle. You do us a great service!
completion: I can only hope that those charged with collecting ram hides are as determined as you, $N . $B At this rate, we will have the stables full in a matter of hours!

name: Ram Hide Harnesses
progress:
While some of our soldiers are busy capturing wolves for the stable master, others must provide for the simple necessities that riding requires. I am speaking of riding harnesses, of course. $B You must strike at the indigenous rams of the region. The very same rams that the Stormpike cavalry uses as mounts! $B Slay them and return to me with their hides. Once we have gathered enough hides, we will fashion harnesses for the riders. The Frostwolf Wolf Riders will ride once more!
Alterac Ram Hide ( 1 )
completion: Well done, soldier. I will notify you when I have stockpiled enough of the hides. $B Carry on!

name: Ram Riding Harnesses
progress:
The Stormpike Brigade cannot charge into battle bareback! We require harnesses for our mounts, after all, we are not savages. $B While we could easily slay the rams that roam near our base for the leather required to fashion a harness, doing so would be idiotic. We need those rams for mounts. $B You must strike at our enemy's base, slaying the frostwolves they use as mounts and taking their hides. Return their hides to me so that harnesses may be made for the cavalry. Go!
Frostwolf Hide ( 1 )
completion: Well done, soldier. I will notify you when I have stockpiled enough of the hides. $B Carry on!

name: Empty Stables
details: Just look at the stables, $N ! Empty! The Stormpike Brigade has no rams to ride - the cavalry is defunct. $B You must help us, soldier. Take this training collar and enter the wilds of this valley. Locate the Alterac rams that roam throughout the area and use the collar to snare one. When you have captured a ram, return it to me and I shall place it in our stable. $B When we have enough rams, the ram rider commander will be notifed. With your help, the cavalry will be reborn!
progress: Without your help, the Stormpike Ram Riders would not have mounts to ride into battle. You do us a great service!
completion: The stables will be full in no time at all. Keep up the good work!

name: The Legend of Korrak
details: The invading Stormpike are not the only threat in the region, soldier. The war in the Valley is waged on two fronts. The cannibal Winterax trolls also vie for power. $B They are lead by Korrak the Bloodrager - a cruel and cunning beast. $B A strike against Korrak could prove to be a crushing blow to the Winterax clan. Slay the beast and be rewarded!

name: Korrak the Bloodrager
details: The indigenous Winterax trolls of the region are ruthless savages that would love nothing more than to have our bones added to their foul stew. $B We must show them our might! $B We have recovered tomes from their caves that detail their leadership hierarchy. The artifacts indicate that their leader, Korrak the Bloodrager, tends to remain hidden until given a reason to make his presence known. $B Death to Korrak would mean death to Winterax Clan! Slay him and return.

name: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer
details: Ah, $N , reporting for duty are you? Great, the Stormpikes can use everyone we can muster! $B Speak with Prospector Stonehewer in Dun Baldar. She's recruiting for a vital mission into enemy territory. You'll find Stonehewer in the bottom of the Dun Baldar garrison. $B And keep an eye out as you go through Dun Baldar. There's plenty to do for a hardworking $C who's not afraid to get hands dirty.

name: Speak with Voggah Deathgrip
details: A $C ? Good! We are glad to see you in Alterac, $N . Interloping dwarves and their allies invade our valley, and we welcome all in the Horde to join us in righteous slaughter! $B Speak with Voggah Deathgrip. He is looking for agents for an important mission into the Alliance's stronghold in Alterac Valley! $B You will find Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.

name: A Fair Trade
progress:
Greetings, $R . I am Kolark, Bounty $C from Thunderbluff. Much of the world I have traveled and much I have seen. $B My journeys across the South Seas led to the discovery of these wonderous thorium headed arrows. Alas, I have an endless supply of the arrows but have exhausted my supply of shells. Bah, no self respecting Tauren would ever be caught dead using a flimsy bow. The arrows are useless! $B I will offer a trade: An even exchange of thorium shells for my thorium headed arrows. Deal?
Thorium Shells ( 200 )
completion: Excellent! I am a Tauren of my word, $R . The arrows are yours.

name: Arrows Are For Sissies
progress:
Can you believe this rubbish?! The last shipment of ammunition from Kharanos was botched! All we have for ammo now are these flimsy, good for nothing arrows! What in the world am I going to do with 500,000 thorium headed arrows? $B I'll tell you what, kid. If you can bring me thorium shells, I'll trade you thorium headed arrows - straight up! Deal?
Thorium Shells ( 200 )
completion: A done deal if I ever saw one! The arrows are yours.

name: Gnomeregan Bounty
details: The High Tinkerer himself has sent me to this field of battle to defend my gnomish brothers and sisters. We have received word that the tauren are singling out and slaying gnomes. Worst of all, they are removing tufts of glorious gnome hair from the corpses of the fallen. These atrocities must be stopped. We must reciprocate! $B I want them de-hoofed, $C . Bring me their hooves! Show yourself as an ally of the gnomes.

name: Staghelm's Requiem
details: Staghelm has given the order. All trolls on the field of battle must be exterminated. Their preposterous claims of birthing night elves must be met with force and due prejudice. $B Slay them and return to me with their mojo. To reiterate: I want you to steal their mojo.

name: Defusing the Threat
details: The Frostwolf have their front lines and bases booby trapped, $C . You have to watch your step when invading enemy territory. $B If you want to make a solid strike against them, you must destroy their source of anti personnel munitions - I'm talking about their explosives expert. If you kill him, you are safe to disarm the mines. As long as he is kept down, the mines will also stay down. $B You will probably find him in a tower near the Iceblood Garrison. Good luck!

name: Defusing the Threat
details: I know all about landmines. I'm the one that lays all the mines on the front lines here, after all. $B If you want to defuse the Stormpike mine fields, all you have to do is kill their explosives expert. That dwarven coward is no doubt hiding in the first tower on the Field of Strife. Take him out and those landmines won't come back after they've been disarmed. $B If you do happen to kill him, come back here and let me know. No good deed should go unrewarded.

name: The Return of Korrak
details: While it is true that Korrak has been slain, one question remains: Will he remain dead? Trolls are notorious for their other-worldly tribal magics. I would not be surprised if the fallen leader was raised from the dead to once more rule over his clan. $B You know what to do should this ever occur. $B <Warmaster Laggrond makes a cutting motion across his neck with his index finger.> $B And this time, I want his skull. Just keep your eyes peeled, soldier. $B Dismissed!

name: Korrak the Everliving
details: There's something not quite right about all of this... Did anybody think to burn Korrak's corpse? Those trolls will stop at nothing to revive their fallen leader - as blue skinned pagan man-beasts often do. $B Just keep your eyes out, $N . Don't be alarmed if Korrak makes a surprise appearance; and if he does, I want him executed - his corpse burned to ashes. $B For good measure, lop off his head and bring me his skull before you ignite the lifeless mass.

name: A Gallon of Blood
progress:
You have the option of offering larger quantities of the blood taken from our enemies. I will be glad to accept gallon sized offerings, $N .
Stormpike Soldier's Blood ( 5 )
completion: The blood of our enemies has been shed. I shall mix this blood with the rest that has been gathered. Once the offering is complete, the Ice Lord shall show these Stormpike dogs the full wrath of the Frostwolf Clan!

name: Crystal Cluster
progress:
There are times which you may be entrenched in battle for days or weeks on end. During those longer periods of activity you may end up collecting large clusters of the Frostwolf's storm crystals. $B The Circle accepts such offerings, $N .
Storm Crystal ( 5 )
completion: Well done, $N . I will use the power of these charms to augment the magic that has already been gathered. When enough power has been amassed, I shall focus the collected energies and call upon the Forest Lord to aid our cause.

name: WANTED: Orcs!
details: By order of Corporal Noreg Stormpike, all able bodied soldiers of Stormpike are required to slay any opposing orcs that they meet upon the field of battle. $B Soldiers are required to remove a tusk or tooth from the maw of the enemy and present said tooth as proof of their accomplishment. $B Wear protective gloves.

name: I've Got A Fever For More Bone Chips
Free Knot!
progress:
It's called the Gordok Shackle Key - well, that's what these "tons o' fun" keep calling it. I think any of the ogres might have it, but I'm not sure if any specific ones do. Maybe the guards have a better chance of having one... $B What am I talking about - you have it already, don't you?! Is that it there??!
Gordok Shackle Key ( 1 )
completion: Oh, thank you for freeing me! You - ranked number one. Everyone else - ranked number two or lower. $B I knew my life was destined for more than just being an appetizer to some ogre!

name: Libram of Rapidity
details: Master Dreamseeker lost the Libram of Rapidity in the east wing. The Libram will allow for a minor haste cantrip to be placed upon your equipment. Parlor tricks, really... $B Regardless, if you are interested, you will need to present the Libram along with some basic reagents. $B Hrm... I believe it also requires blood of heroes, a pristine black diamond, and large brilliant shards. I could be wrong! $B
progress: What is it? I have much cataloguing to do!
completion: $B As promised, the Arcanum of Rapidity. Don't spend it all in once place. $B

name: Libram of Focus
details: This libram almost aroused interest in one of the younger Lorekeeper's familiars. Poor thing, it was only a few weeks old. $B Those among you who are more magically inclined might find this item interesting. $B The Libram of Focus was lost in this wing. I can only assume one of the Highborne spirits holds it in their possession. $B Bring the Libram along with some large brilliant shards, skin of shadow, and a pristine black diamond and I shall conjure the Arcanum.
progress: You again? What could you possibly want now?
completion: Don't hurt yourself when applying the enchantment, $R .

name: Libram of Protection
details: He wept like an infant at the loss of this libram. Mind you, I myself have wept over texts - there is no greater loss than that of knowledge and history - but to cry over this nearly useless jumbling of incantations? Preposterous! It left me to believe that the Prince was doing him a favor in flaying the flesh from his bones. $B Bring the Libram along with a pristine black diamond, large brilliant shards, and a frayed abomination stitching and I shall recreate the Arcanum. $B Oh, and check the north wing.
progress: My patience prevents your suffering.
completion: Yes, yes... Calm yourself. As promised, here is your Arcanum.

name: The Journey Has Just Begun
completion: A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. I am humbled. $B Please accept what I am about to teach you. This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight. $B Create the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... Nefarian.

name: The Journey Has Just Begun
completion: A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. I am humbled. $B Please accept what I am about to teach you. This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight. $B Create the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... Nefarian.

name: Service to the Horde
completion: It will take time for our scholars to study the pendant you brought us. But for your service to the Horde I would like to offer you a small token. $B Thank you, $N . Your acts bring honor to you, and to us.

name: A Warning
completion: $C , you are about to undergo a rigorous series of events which shall test all of your abilities. $B I suggest that you listen to the story that I have to tell. $B Be warned, you must complete this task alone. It is recommended that your allies remain at a distance. Interference by outside agents will result in a most severe punishment. $B Destiny has led you and you alone here. Battle with honor. Harness the Light.

name: An Introduction
completion: Your diligence and integrity has been noted, $C . $B We are Ancients: Protectors of this once great forest. Our physical forms were destroyed 10,000 years ago when Archimonde and the Burning Legion marched upon Hyjal. Our spirits, however, remain intact. $B There are tasks that we can offer. Tasks that if completed will open up the secrets of the Ancients to you. $B Know this, should you complete these tasks, merely return to this rock and we shall answer the calling.

name: A Blue Light Bargain
completion: Aright, mister, I got a hot deal for ya. $B I'm lookin' to offload some of these here Imperial plate armor recipes and need someone willing to take on the burden. All I want in exchange is some thorium bars. Sound good?

name: Imperial Plate Belt
progress:
For the belt plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars.
Thorium Bar ( 20 )
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya. $B And $N , wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

name: Imperial Plate Boots
progress: For the boot plans, I'll be needin' 40 thorium bars. Yep, 40. Are you gonna cry? Would you like a hanky? $B Thorium Bar ( 40 )
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya. $B And $N , wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

name: Imperial Plate Bracer
progress:
For the bracer plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars. $B Are you alright, sonny? Yer getting' all red.
Thorium Bar ( 20 )
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya. $B And $N , wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

name: Imperial Plate Chest
progress:
For the chest piece plans, I'll be needin' 60 thorium bars. $B Oh boy, there you go again. Are you gonna be runnin' to yer blue Gods, askin' why they have forsaken you?!? Toughen up, Nancy! Nobody ever said life's fair.
Thorium Bar ( 60 )
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya. $B And $N , wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

name: Imperial Plate Helm
progress:
Just hand over 50 thorium bars and the helm plans are yers.
Thorium Bar ( 50 )
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya. $B And $N , wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

name: Imperial Plate Leggings
progress:
Just hand over 60 thorium bars and the leg plans are yers. $B I know, I'm driving you into bankruptcy! I've heard it all before so you can save your sob story, weakling.
Thorium Bar ( 60 )
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya. $B And $N , wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

name: Imperial Plate Shoulders
progress:
For the shoulder plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars.
Thorium Bar ( 20 )
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya. $B And $N , wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

name: Again Into the Great Ossuary
completion: Are you headed back into the Scholomance, $N ? You've already paid such a great price for the use of the Divination Scryer - perhaps you'd like to take another one with you. With it, you'd be able to face the perils of the Great Ossuary once more. $B By all means, have it. You've certainly earned it.

name: Again With the Zapped Giants
details: I know you've gathered residue for me already... but should you find yourself for want of an encore performance to a fun-time activity, I can always use more residue. $B While I can't offer nearly as much in the way of compensation again, I'll be more than happy to spread the good word of your service to all my goblin friends with ears. $B Believe me when I say that these goblins have quite large ears.
progress: Ah, the fruits of research and utilization in the form of sweet, sweet residue. Well, that is to say, I don't taste it or anything when I study it. $B Much.
completion: Inconceivably fantastical, $N ! You've come through for me again, and for that I thank you. $B Thank you! $B While you may find this coin to be a little less than you're accustomed to, rest assured your great deeds on the field of goblindom are echoing through the halls of power in the Steamwheedle Cartel. Should you need something else to do, then by all means talk to me!

name: Refuel for the Zapping
details: More work, you say? Did my heroic mission of collecting bits of goo found inside elemental beings not slake your thirst for adventure? Perhaps more of the same will vainly try to fill the bottomless well of questing you possess... $B OK, melodrama aside, I do need more water elemental cores. I'm trying desperately to set up shop here, so the rewards won't be as great... but I promise you I'll tell everyone in earshot how you've helped me. Trust me on this - I know people in the Cartel!
progress: Have you managed to find the elemental cores I need?
completion: Top notch, $N , top notch! While the coin I give you might not be the most you'll ever receive for such work, rest assured my comrades in the Steamwheedle Cartel will hear about your efforts! $B If you are looking for anything else to do, then let me know. I can always use more elemental cores and such.

name: Pristine Yeti Hide
details: You have found a pristine yeti hide that is exceptionally thick and sturdy - more so than even the ones you've seen from the yeti in Rage Scar. $B Considering that Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold is in the market for yeti hides, this particular one may be of considerable interest to him.
progress: What's this, $N - you've got something special for me?
completion: Incredible! You may have found the granddaddy of all yeti hides with this! $B You better believe I'll pay you for it. I normally don't pay that much for a single hide, but I'm pretty sure I can make something special from it. Thanks for thinking of me on this, $N !

name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood
progress:
Let's not waste more of my precious time with jibber jabber, $R . It's time to focus on replenishing our dwindling fiery flux supply. $B What I'm gonna need from you is the following: $B *Incendosaur scales. $B *Kingsblood. $B *Coal. $B I'll take all that you can offer! $B And you'll do it fast if you wanna get in good with the Brotherhood.
Incendosaur Scale ( 2 )
Kingsblood ( 4 )
Coal ( 1 )
completion: There's always room for more fiery flux, junior. Keep it comin'... unless I tell you to stop.

name: Gaining Acceptance
progress:
You've worked your way up through the Brotherhood's corporate hierarchy, $R . We have begun to look favorably upon you. Quite an accomplishment! $B If you're interested in more work and earning more respect amongst us, listen up. $B We can refine the fiery flux by adding a simple Dark Iron residue to the mix. The Dark Iron residue can be found in Blackrock Depths. $B Bring me all the Dark Iron residue you find!
Dark Iron Residue ( 4 )
completion: Keep the residue pouring in!

name: Perfect Yeti Hide
details: You have found what may very well be a perfect yeti hide. You easily note that it is exceptionally thick and sturdy - more so than even the ones you've seen from the yeti in Rage Scar. $B Considering that Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache is in the market for yeti hides, this particular one may be of considerable interest to him.
progress: What's this, $N - you've got something special for me?
completion: This is an incredible find! I believe this is the finest yeti hide specimen I have ever seen! $B Indeed, this is certainly worthy of an appropriate bounty. I normally don't pay that much for a single hide, but I'm confident I can make something special from it. Thanks for thinking of me on this, $N !

name: Vanquish the Invaders!
details: Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young $C . The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war. $B Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces! $B Do this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, $N , and I shall reward you.

name: A Donation of Wool
progress:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions. Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive. $B If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
Wool Cloth ( 60 )
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N !

name: A Donation of Wool

name: Carnival Boots
progress:
We at the Darkmoon Faire do much walking. We walk from one faire site to another... in fact, you'll never see us sitting down on the job! So it is no surprise that we wear out quite a lot of boots! We need boots that are both durable and stylish, and embossed leather boots fit that bill rather well. $B You! You're a leatherworker; make me embossed leather boots and I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for the work.
Embossed Leather Boots ( 3 )
completion: Thank you, $N . These are quite well made. The craftsmanship is top notch! Here is a Darkmoon Faire ticket... enjoy, sir.

name: Carnival Jerkins
progress:
Our Faire workers do more than sweep trash and hammer spikes! They also help guard the carnival as it travels, and to that end they are always needing good sturdy armor jerkins. $B If you make some tough leather armor and bring it to me, then I'll make sure it gets to the right people. I'll also get you some Darkmoon Faire tickets as trade.
Toughened Leather Armor ( 3 )
completion: Ah, you brought the jerkins. Splendid. What animal's skin did you use to make these, may I ask? The stitch-work is very well done, and the texture of the leather has a rugged style to it. I can tell you are a craftsman of skill! $B Thank you, $N , and here are your tickets.

name: The World's Largest Gnome!
progress:
Yebb Nebblegear is looking to add more talent to his show, and he's searching far and wide for the world's largest gnome. Do you know any gnomes of considerable size? $B Well before he finds the gnome, he wants to have its costume ready. I think a barbaric harness would be a good foundation for the costume; can you make some harnesses and bring them to me? Do that, and I'll have a stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you...
Barbaric Harness ( 3 )
completion: Oh dear, these are quite large!! I can't imagine finding a gnome that would fit snuggly into them, but not to worry - if the gnome we find is not big enough, I can make adjustments to his costume. $B Many thanks, $N . Here are the tickets I promised you.

name: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc
progress:
Yebb is working on other attractions for his zoo, including wet, swampy abodes for a boy raised by crocolisks, and perhaps for a murloc. We will need nice, water-tight leggings so we won't get waterlogged during prop-ups and tear-downs. For that job, I think turtlescale leggings will do the trick. $B $N , can you make those leggings? If you do, then a fat stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets will be your reward...
Turtle Scale Leggings ( 1 )
completion: Great, you made them! These will do nicely... I just hope I won't be the one to clean the crocolisk cage when the time comes. Those beasts can be rather beastly, don't you think? $B Here are your tickets, $N . Enjoy them, and enjoy your stay at the Darkmoon Faire!

name: Armor Kits
progress:
You might not realize this, but running a traveling carnival is costly! Everything wears down so fast it's a wonder we can turn a profit. $B Because of all those hidden costs, we're always looking for ways to maintain our equipment as cheaply as possible. Our tents, for instance, tear regularly but I've found that leather armor kits make great patches. Can you find and bring me some armor kits? That'll save us a bundle! Do that, and I have a fistful of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you...
Rugged Armor Kit ( 8 )
completion: Great! This will work great! I just noticed a rip in a tent over yonder, and one of these armor kits is just what I need to patch it up! $B Thank you very much, $N . These armor kits will save us a ton in repair costs. Here are your tickets - you deserve them!

name: Coarse Weightstone
progress:
It takes a lot of work to be the strongest woman alive! My weight set is getting too light and if I'm too stay fit then I'll need more weights! $B Do you think you could bring me some weight stones? If you do, then I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket.
Coarse Weightstone ( 10 )
completion: Great! These will work great! They're not too heavy, but not too light either. They're perfect for building muscle mass! $B Thanks much, $N . Here's your Darkmoon Faire ticket!

name: Heavy Grinding Stone
progress:
To help with my workout, I like to fit a staff between heavy grinding stones, then lift the staff over my head. It isn't easy, but being the strongest woman in the world, like I am, can't be earned sitting down! $B Can you help me? I need more grinding stones - bring me some and I'll trade Darkmoon Faire tickets for them.
Heavy Grinding Stone ( 7 )
completion: You brought the stones! And they're heavy! I can already feel my muscles getting bigger. Thanks $N ! $B Here, take these tickets, and be sure not to eat too many sweets while you're at the faire. A big strong $C like you needs to keep himself in fighting shape!

name: Green Iron Bracers
progress:
I'm working on a new costume, for when I have my own booth as the strongest woman alive! Right now I'm looking for some bracers I can wear. They can't cover much because people want to see my muscles, but I still want to flash a little color, you know? $B How about green iron bracers, $N ? Can you make me green iron bracers? If you can, then I have a whole bunch of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
Green Iron Bracers ( 3 )
completion: Yes! These are exactly what I need! Such a lovely color, and they still leave my arms bare so you can see how strong they are! Perfect! $B Here you are, $N . Here are your tickets - enjoy!

name: Big Black Mace
progress:
For my act as the strongest woman alive, I plan to accept items from the audience and smash them with a big, black mace! $B Can you make me a big black mace, $N ?
Big Black Mace ( 1 )
completion: Ah, perfect! This mace has a big, heavy head on it. I bet I could smash just about anything with it. I just hope I don't break it along with whatever I swing it against! $B Here are your tickets, $N . Enjoy your stay at the faire!

name: Rituals of Strength
progress:
$N , in my quest to become the strongest woman alive, I have traveled the world and learned muscle building secrets from distant weight masters, strength gurus, and ancient manuals. I now know forbidden exercises that would kill the weak and cripple the uninitiated! $B These feats of strength and conditioning require training with the densest of grinding stones. $N , can you find or make some grinding stones and bring them to me? I'll give you tickets if you do...
Dense Grinding Stone ( 8 )
completion: Thank you, $N . I will use these stones in a strength-gaining ritual I learned from an ancient tablet in the deepest jungles of Stranglethorn. $B It is said that she who performs this sacred rite correctly will have the strength and endurance of ten Tauren!

name: Copper Modulator
progress:
Yebb is developing a new attraction for the Zoo Bizarre, one that will drive people crazy with wonder, and delight! But it will take a lot of work, and a lot of materials... $B That includes copper modulators. We need lots of modulators for the mechanical parts of the attraction. Bring me copper modulators and I'll trade for them with a Darkmoon Faire ticket.
Copper Modulator ( 5 )
completion: Aha! The modulators! Superb! $B I can't tell you exactly what we're building, but these will be invaluable for its construction. I am in your debt, $N , but please, take this Darkmoon Faire ticket as a token of my appreciation.

name: Whirring Bronze Gizmo
progress:
My new booth will be a sight to see, yes sir! A sight to see, and... for a lucky few, to touch! $B I can already hear the whirring bronze gizmos singing their song of mechanical rapture as patrons step to my booth and test their skill! $B Ah... now I need the gizmos themselves to bring my dream closer to fruition. Please, $N , bring me whirring bronze gizmos... and Darkmoon Faire tickets will be yours!
Whirring Bronze Gizmo ( 7 )
completion: You brought the gizmos! Wonderful! Even now I can hear their buzzing, whirring chorus in my mind! Oh, when this booth is ready it will be the wonder of the world, mark me! $B Here are you tickets, $N . And please enjoy your stay at the Faire!

name: Green Fireworks
progress:
When I finally get this booth up and running, I'll want to advertise! And what better way is there to advertise then with fireworks? $B Well, some might think that the smell of a cauldron, churning with the boiling heads of your foes is better for drawing crowds, but... we're in mixed company. So fireworks it will have to be! $B Bring me green fireworks, $N , and I have a big fistful of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
Green Firework ( 36 )
completion: You brought the fireworks. Wonderful work, $N ! I can't wait to light these and tell the world that my booth is ready to go! I must still wait, quite a long time I'm afraid, but... I'll be ready when I'm ready, yes? $B Here are the tickets, $N . Enjoy yourself!

name: Mechanical Repair Kits
progress:
The biggest reason I can't open up my booth is that... everything's broken! I need mechanical repair kits to fix all this stuff! $B Can you bring me those kits, $N ? I'll trade you... kits for Darkmoon Faire tickets. What do you say?
Mechanical Repair Kit ( 6 )
completion: Thank you! Now I can get to fixing things. $B It's going to take a lot of repair kits and a lot of late nights to get everything in working order. Sometimes I think it'd be better to get back to my roots and restart my career as a headhunter, but... the Faire has been good to me. $B Take these tickets, $N , and have fun!

name: Thorium Widget
progress:
Yebb Nebblegear, like me, is working on a future attraction. So amazing is this attraction, says Nebb, that it will draw folks from across the world... and it will make us all very, very rich! $B He says he needs thorium widgets for its construction, and wants me to collect them for him. So what do you say, $N ? Do you know where to get thorium widgets? If you're an engineer, can you make them? Do you want to trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets?
Thorium Widget ( 6 )
completion: Ah, thank you, $N ! Yebb will enjoy these widgets. I don't know what he has planned for them, but Yebb's a clever little gnome. He's clever, and maybe a little devious.... $B If only he liked the taste of humanoid flesh... he'd make a great troll! $B Here, $N . A deal's a deal, and these tickets are yours.

name: Small Furry Paws
progress:
The first lesson in drawing a crowd is: lure them with gadgets and trinkets! Can you help me? $B I need small furry paws to use for prizes. You can find those on the cats of the Barrens or Darkshore.... $B Bring me some paws and I'll trade you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for them.
Small Furry Paw ( 5 )
completion: Great, you got them! We can use these to make toys and baubles, and those will attract more people to the Faire! $B Here's your ticket, $N . You earned it!

name: Torn Bear Pelts
progress:
Children love toys! And no matter what race, I've found that all children love furry, plushy toys made from torn bear pelts! $B You can get those pelts from the bears of Ashenvale or Hillsbrad. Bring me a heap of them and earn yourself a heap of Darkmoon Faire tickets!
Torn Bear Pelt ( 5 )
completion: Nice pelts, $N ! I'll get someone to sew these into a bunch of plush toys. With a little stuffing and some paint, I think they'll be the envy of children across Azeroth! $B Tickets? Ah yes, your payment! Here they are!

name: Soft Bushy Tails
progress:
It's amazing what people value! Take, for instance, a wooden stick with a soft bushy tail attached to it. Now, you and I might think something like that isn't all that valuable... but if you give that piece of junk a neat name like "Savage Fuzz Tail" and put it in a pretty box, then people will think it's valuable. Trash becomes treasure! $B Get me soft bushy tails from the wolves of Desolace and the Badlands, and I'll give you Darkmoon Faire tickets.
Soft Bushy Tail ( 5 )
completion: Well done, $N ! These tails will make great prizes for our visitors, and that means happy visitors... who talk to their friends and bring more visitors! $B Here are your tickets! Have a good time at the Darkmoon Faire... and don't forget to tell your friends about us!

name: Vibrant Plumes
progress:
A person's imagination is an incredible thing. It can make the smallest hill seem like the largest mountain. It can make the most innocuous shadow appear cast by a horrible nightmare! $B We at the Darkmoon Faire let our visitor's imaginations blossom! But to help stretch their imaginations... sometimes we have to get tricky. $B I need vibrant plumes for one of my attractions. You can get them from the birds of the more dangerous areas of Azeroth. Bring me the plumes and many tickets will be yours!
Vibrant Plume ( 5 )
completion: Ah, the plumes! They are amazing, don't you think! It would be easy to spark one's imaginations with such beauties! $B You do such charitable work, $N . The smiles on our visitors' faces when they see the show is a grand payment indeed, but please take these tickets as well.

name: Evil Bat Eyes
progress:
Do you ever find yourself wandering in a cave, late at night, looking for adventure? You do? Really? Well, then you've seen the creepy eyes of bats staring at you from high up, waiting for you to let down your guard so they can suck your blood! $B Scary thought, don't you think? Of course! It's no doubt that bat eyes are scary! $B Will you bring me some evil bat eyes, $N ? I want them for... something I'm designing. Something scary. $B You can get them from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands.
Evil Bat Eye ( 10 )
completion: Great! You got the eyes! I hope hunting those bats was frightening for you, because if it scared a brave $C like yourself, then those eyes will certainly scare our Faire visitors. $B Take these tickets, $N , and thank you for your service.

name: Darkmoon Beast Deck
details: Now that you have gathered all of the Beast cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight. On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.
progress: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of beasts! Congratulations!
completion: So you have put together a deck of Beasts. Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten. Allow me to present you with one of the greater darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.

name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
details: "Your fortune awaits you in Eastvale." $B The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch. Grasping it firmly, you see an image of the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. Focusing closer in on the image, you see a haystack that sits next to a stable.
progress: This haystack looks like the one from your vision.
completion: A quick search of the haystack reveals a lockbox from within it! It would seem that you have found your fortune!

name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
details: "Your fortune awaits you inside the Deadmines." $B The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch. Grasping it firmly, you see an image of the Deadmines inside Westfall's ruined hamlet of Moonbrook. Focusing closer in on the image, you wind about twisty passages until you reach a shimmering portal... one that leads into the heart of the mines itself. Stepping through it, a strange chest appears out from nowhere.
progress: This chest looks like the one from your vision...
completion: A quick search of the chest reveals a lockbox from within it! It would seem that you have found your fortune!

name: More Dense Grinding Stones
progress:
$N , thank you for all the help you've given me. I really can't thank you enough! $B Although my need is no longer great... if you bring me more dense grinding stones, I still have more Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
Dense Grinding Stone ( 8 )
completion: Again, thank you $N . Please enjoy these tickets, and tell your friends about the Darkmoon Faire!

name: More Armor Kits
progress:
$N , I must thank you for all your help. I have plenty of supplies, through no small efforts on your part, but if you wish to bring me more armor kits, then I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets.
Rugged Armor Kit ( 8 )
completion: There you are, $N . A fair trade. Enjoy.

name: More Thorium Widgets
progress:
$N , you have been so good to us, bringing me goods without tiring. You have my eternal thanks! $B Although our need for Thorium widgets is not as great as it was, you may still bring them to me and I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets.
Thorium Widget ( 6 )
completion: Here you are, $N . Here are Darkmoon Faire tickets for your enjoyment. Do not, as they say, spend them all in one place!

name: More Bat Eyes
progress:
$N , the attraction I'm designing will be the scariest event since Gnomeregan was overrun! And it's largely thanks to you and all the baubles you've brought me. Many, many thanks! $B I don't need much else, but... if you bring me more evil bat eyes from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands... I might have more Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
Evil Bat Eye ( 10 )
completion: Thanks again, $N . Here are your tickets!

Focusing closer in on the image, you wind about twisty passages until you reach a shimmering portal... one that leads into the heart of the caverns itself. Stepping through it, a strange chest appears out from nowhere.
progress: This chest looks like the one from your vision...
completion: A quick search of the chest reveals a lockbox from within it! It would seem that you have found your fortune!

progress: This tree stump looks like the one from your vision.
completion: A quick search of the tree stump reveals a lockbox from within it! It would seem that you have found your fortune!

name: Spawn of Jubjub
progress:
I'm so happy Jubjub is no longer lost. She loves Dark Iron ale so much that when I ran out... she ran away to find more! $B Now that Jubjub's back, I want as much ale as I can get! I won't want her to run away again! $B Do you have any Dark Iron Ale? If you do, then I'll trade you one of Jubjub's frog eggs for a mug...
Dark Iron Ale Mug ( 1 )
completion: Thank you, $N . Here is your egg! It won't be ready to hatch for a little while, but when it does you'll have a great pet!

name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
completion: Hail, $C . I am Jin'rokh the Breaker, troll of Mugamba. We of the Zandalar tribe recognize your accomplishments. We salute your tenacity and strength of will. $B Wear this talisman around your neck, $C . Let the strength of Mount Mugamba flow through your being. Be empowered as you strike down our enemies!

name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
progress:
It is good to see you in good health, $N . The glorious battles you have undertaken affect all life on this planet. Hakkar must never leave the confines of Zul'Gurub as the world will surely collapse beneath his immense hunger. $B Give me your talisman and I shall amplify its strength. Use the Strength of Mugamba to punish our enemies!
Strength of Mugamba ( 1 )
completion: Our paths will cross again, $C .

name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
progress:
Master $N , you return! Molthor has sent word of your deeds to the King. Your name is known even in the South Seas. Perhaps one day you will be a legendary $C - a story for the ages. $B Give me your talisman so that I may once more amplify its power.
Strength of Mugamba ( 1 )
completion: Use your newfound strength to destroy the Gurubashi!

name: The Heathen's Brand
completion: Know this, heathen: A catastrophe has brought us together. Your pagan ways are neither understood nor appreciated by Zandalar but we are a fair people. Wear this brand around your neck. It shall serve as both a warning to our enemies and a symbol of your friendship to Zandalar. $B Continue to serve our people and I will amplify the power of the brand.

name: The Heathen's Brand
progress:
I may have been too hasty in my judgement, $C . It seems as if your blind faith in this Light has some value after all. $B Give me your brand and I shall amplify its power.
Heathen's Brand ( 1 )
completion: Do what you must to defeat our enemies, $C . Even if it means channeling the Light.

name: The Heathen's Brand
progress:
I must confess, I did not think you had the resolution to see this cause through, $C . Zandalar now considers you an invaluable ally. Well done, indeed. $B Give me your brand and I shall once more amplify its power.
Heathen's Brand ( 1 )
completion: Our beliefs differ but our cause is righteous. Strike down our foes, noble $C .

name: The Hero's Brand
progress:
The King has acknowledged your existence, $C . You are the first of your kind to be accepted by Rastakhan as a true ally of Zandalar. $B You will be rewarded greatly for your efforts. Present your brand and I shall apply the final amplification.
Heathen's Brand ( 1 )
completion: Vigilance, honor, loyalty, bravery... You embody all of these traits and so shall your brand.

name: The Eye of Zuldazar
completion: Accept this talisman as a token of our appreciation, $C . $B The Eye of Zuldazar will grow in power as your bond with the trolls of Zandalar strengthens. Return to me periodically and I shall imbue the jewel.

name: The Eye of Zuldazar
progress:
Welcome $C . The Eye of Zuldazar pulses with energy. You are ready to take the next step. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the imbue.
The Eye of Zuldazar ( 1 )
completion: Continue in your battle against the Soulflayer and his minions, $N . He must never be permitted to leave the confines of Zul'Gurub.

name: The Eye of Zuldazar
progress:
Tales of your battles against the Gurubashi are whispered in the winds, $C . Even royalty is beginning to talk of your deeds. It is rumored that King Rastakhan even mentioned you by name. $B The time has come to imbue the Eye. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the service.
The Eye of Zuldazar ( 1 )
completion: Be resolute in your endeavors, $N . The Soulflayer will attempt to siphon your will to live.

name: The All-Seeing Eye of Zuldazar
progress:
If only we had ten-thousand more like you, $N . The armies of Hakkar would be scattered to the wind in the blink of an eye. $B Alas, the Eye is ready to realize its full potential. Give it to me.
The Eye of Zuldazar ( 1 )
completion: Smite them all and let Hakkar sort them out...

name: The Pebble of Kajaro
completion: $R , the pebble held within the frame of this talisman comes from Mount Kajaro in the South Seas. Mount Kajaro is an area plagued by volatility - marked by violent and oftentimes magical volcanic eruptions. $B As your bond with the trolls of Zandalar grows, so too shall the power of this pebble. Harness the power of the pebble to strike down our enemies. Be like the mountain: Quick, explosive, deadly...

name: The Pebble of Kajaro
progress:
Welcome back, $C . I can see that the pebble has seen much use. Many of our foes have fallen to your otherworldly abilities. Their suffering has been great. It is time that I enhance the power of the pebble. Give it to me.
Pebble of Kajaro ( 1 )
completion: Be unstoppable, like the molten fronts of Kajaro.

name: The Pebble of Kajaro
progress:
Hakkari fear you, $N . They speak of horrors they believed that only their faceless God could perpetrate. You have burned them with the force of Kajaro. They now know fear in two places. $B It is time to further strengthen the pebble. Hand me the talisman.
Pebble of Kajaro ( 1 )
completion: Continue in your decimation of the trolls of Zul'Gurub. Hakkar must see that the world will not buckle beneath his indomitable will.

name: The Jewel of Kajaro
progress:
Give me the talisman, $N . I must show you something.
Pebble of Kajaro ( 1 )
completion: $B Do you see? The pebble is what we call a geode. Inside the pebble are powerful crystals that have been soaking in the latent energies from our world. By cutting the pebble in half, I have finally allowed its full potential to be realized. Use it to lay waste to our enemies.

name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
details: $N , the battle for Arathi Basin is a battle for resources and territory. Key points in the area must be held and operated in order to supply our forces with much needed raw materials and supplies. I charge you to assault the points farthest from our Arathi Basin base. $B Assault the farm, the mine, the lumber mill and the blacksmith when they are controlled by the enemy. Find the enemy's banner and rip it from its flag post! $B When you have done this to all four points, return to me.
completion: I received reports of your exploits in Arathi Basin, $N . Well done! With those like you joining the struggles here, I have faith that we will one day retake our homelands.

name: Kezan's Taint
completion: Accept this talisman, $C . Accept it and use its power to strike down our mutual enemies. $B Know that around your neck you carry a piece of history. Kezan was once a grand territory of the Zandalar Empire. Alas, the taint of goblin trade princes would force out my proud brothers and sisters. $B Kezan is now home to the goblin capital of the Undermine; but know that before the taint, it held greatness. Still to this day Kezan is considered sacred land to my people.

name: Kezan's Taint
progress:
Honor is earned amongst the Zandalar trolls, $N . With honor comes reward - friendship, alliance... $B Hand me the talisman so that I may enhance its power.
Kezan's Taint ( 1 )
completion: Draw from the darkness, $C . Embrace the shadows. Let Kezan's Taint supplement your dark meddling.

name: Kezan's Taint
progress:
I am ready for you, $C . Once more I will enhance your talisman. I only ask that you continue in your destruction of Hakkar and his minions. $B Give me the talisman.
Kezan's Taint ( 1 )
completion: It is only through our combined efforts that we will stop the Soulflayer.

name: Kezan's Unstoppable Taint
progress:
Call forth your demons, $C . Let them bask in the energy of Kezan's Taint. Command them on the field of battle! Decimate the enemy! $B Yes... The time has come to apply the final enhancement to Kezan's Taint. Give me the talisman.
Kezan's Taint ( 1 )
completion: Flay the flesh from their corpses. Watch as the shadows consume the Hakkari. Draw power from their fear, $C . Let Kezan's Taint augment this power...

name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
completion: See this here seaweed, mon? It be from the South Seas. We just add a little mojo and a little magic and it takes on the properties most suited to its owner. $B You a $C so it be easy, mon. Just wrap it around your neck and think of nature or squirrels or whatever it be that you people like.

name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
progress:
Hey mon! It be good to see you again. The tribe be talking about your killin' of the Hakkari and all that. Molthor gave me the word to be adding more mojo to your talisman. Just give it here and Maywiki make it better.
Enchanted South Seas Kelp ( 1 )
completion: The neck piece not be for smokin', mon! You got to use it to fight evil.

name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
progress:
How be that talisman, mon? It look like it be time to add a little more magic and mojo to its leaves. It need a little bloom in its wilt. Give it here and Maywiki fix it right up.
Enchanted South Seas Kelp ( 1 )
completion: Now you take the evil trolls in Zul'Gurub and show them what your nature powers can do, mon!

name: Pristine Enchanted South Seas Kelp
progress:
$N ! It been a long time since I seen you. Did you know that King Rastakhan himself be givin' me the order to add the final bit of mojo and magic to your talisman? It be true, mon! I wouldn't have believed it had I not seen it with me own eyes. Give it here.
Enchanted South Seas Kelp ( 1 )
completion: $N mon, it been a good journey. Keep on with the killing and suppressing of Hakkar and he minions.

name: Control Four Bases
details: $N , you have taken the battle of Arathi Basin to our enemies and earned great honors in that field of battle. You have shown us your worth as a $C , and you have shown our enemies that we will not submit to their villainy! $B Because of your proven value to us, I have a difficult task for you. I want you to take and hold at least four of the bases in Arathi Basin. If you can do that, then we will not only secure critical resources, we will show the Horde our dominance! $B Go, $N , and good fortune.
progress: You have not yet taken four bases, $N . Return to Arathi Basin and do as you have been tasked!
completion: Very good work, $N ! An excited scout came to me with a report of your exploits. We in the League of Arathor are very pleased! $B You are swiftly becoming a local hero among the soldiers in the League, and today's deed once again proves your sterling reputation.

name: Control Five Bases
details: $N , battling for the resources of Arathi Basin is a bloody undertaking. Your services to the League of Arathor are are needed as they are appreciated. $B And we have one more task for you. $B The League wishes to make one strong push against the Defilers' occupation of Arathi Basin. We want them driven out of every strategic point on the battlefield! $B It will not be easy, but if anyone can get it done, it is you.
progress: You have not yet completed your mission, $N . It is difficult, but my faith in you is strong.
completion: You did it! You took all of the bases! Well done, $N ! $B There were those who doubted your chances, but I knew you could do it. Thank you, and know that the League of Arathor holds you in high regard, just as the Defilers of the Forsaken must fear the very mention of your name!

name: Vision of Voodress
completion: You and Maywiki have something in common, mon. We both be $C ! Although, Maywiki is more of a mystic and you be more of a scrub. Still, we both know what the great spirits bring. $B As a gift I give to you this orb to wear around your neck. Look deep inside and see the village of Voodress in the South Seas! Let it lift your spirits!

name: Vision of Voodress
progress:
Sha-mon! Maywiki make a joke! $B So, you been using the spirits and elements against our enemies in Zul'Gurub, eh? Spirits be praised! $B Maywiki gonna brighten your orb. Give it here, $N .
Vision of Voodress ( 1 )
completion: Take a look at it now, $N . Voodress come in even clearer now, yea? Let the primal power flow through you, mon.

name: Vision of Voodress
progress:
Good news, $N . Molthor be singin' your praises lately. He say how you be turnin' into a real hero of Zandalar. $B He also say for Maywiki to polish your orb some more! Give it here so Maywiki can brighten the vision.
Vision of Voodress ( 1 )
completion: Beware the evil Hakkari spirits, mon. Honestly, they be spooky.

name: The Unmarred Vision of Voodress
progress:
$B Look at it, $N ! It's come alive. The spirits dance around the orb. $B Give it to Maywiki so she can make one last adjustment.
Vision of Voodress ( 1 )
completion: One day, $N , you will be able to use this orb to communicate directly with me. Whenever this battle with Hakkar be over and Maywiki go home. Let us call to the spirits and ask them for that day to come soon.

name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
details: As you no doubt have heard, the League of Arathor is sending large numbers of troops into Arathi Basin. Eager for food and supplies, these Alliance fools are intent to take and control the rich resources there. We must show them that Arathi will never again be a home for humans! $B Go to Arathi Basin and assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the stables. Pull down the enemies' banners, declaring those territories for the Horde. $B Go, $N . Report back to me when this task is complete.
completion: A Defiler scout came to me with a report of your success, $N . Well done. $B As you will learn, to win the battle for Arathi Basin, we must be ever vigilant and crush any attempts at Alliance expansion. Do this, and our victory here is ensured.

name: Take Four Bases
details: $N , as the battles over Arathi Basin rage, news of your actions have reached many ears. You are highly regarded among us, which gives me confidence that you will accomplish the mission I now have for you. $B It is time to send a message to the League of Arathor. We must show them that their holdings in Arathi Basin are tenuous and quickly lost. We will show them this by holding, all at once, four strategic points in Arathi Basin. $B Succeed in this, $N , and earn great respect among the Defilers.
progress: Return to Arathi Basin, $N , and perform the task for which you were sent to do! Capture and hold four bases!
completion: Good work, $N ! Your latest actions in Arathi Basin were quite difficult, and so their successes are quite praiseworthy. The League of Arathor must be reeling from the last skirmishes in the basin, licking their wounds and, let us hope, rethinking their choice to fight here.

name: Take Five Bases
details: It is difficult to see, so deep we are in the conflict, but our spies report a weakening in the League of Arathor's resolve. We must use this window and strike a brutal blow against them! Return to Arathi Basin and throw yourself against our foes. Curse them and kill them and control all five strategic bases! Send their soldiers screaming and bleeding from the front lines, with stories of your cruelty on their mewling lips. $B Do this, and score a great victory for the Defilers.
completion: The cries of the Alliance as you and your compatriots attacked them could be heard even from here, $N . I can almost pity them for the pain and fear you delivered to their ranks. Almost, but not quite. $B Your value to the Defilers is without question. Your deeds in Arathi Basin have been most impressive, and have echoed among the chambers of Varimathras... and the Dark Lady herself.

name: Cut Arathor Supply Lines
details: The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies. $B You can help us, $N . Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.

name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
completion: You progress swiftly, young $C . Perhaps it is time to initiate you into the Shera Ali'kh - Zandalari for Death's Hand. For thousands of years we have played the role of assassin for the Zandalar Empire. For too long we have sat idly, allowing the Hakkari to grow in strength. Once more we face Hakkar, but this time without the support of a united troll front. It is you and your allies who must assist in vanquishing the Blood God and his minions! $B Wear this talisman and let it assist you in your journeys.

name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
progress:
I sense that you have dealt countless fatalities to the Hakkari, $N . You carry the stink of their mojo. $B I assume the Shadow talisman has assisted in the culling? Give it to me and allow me to enhance its power.
Zandalarian Shadow Talisman ( 1 )
completion: An assassin of your caliber should be given a wide berth. Your foes must learn respect! You will get just that when the enemy sees the glint of Death's Hand - all too late...

name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
progress:
Impressive, $N . You have a gift for killing that I have not sensed in another in many years. Even Molthor is aware of the work that you have done for Zandalar. It is time to enhance your talisman further. Give it to me.
Zandalarian Shadow Talisman ( 1 )
completion: There is only one enhancement left that can be placed on the talisman, $C . When the time is right, I shall apply that enhancement.

name: Zandalarian Shadow Mastery Talisman
progress:
It yearns to grow, $N . The talisman has soaked in all that you have done. The thousands of troll corpses littering Zul'Gurub have fueled its power. Hand it to me and I shall make the final enhancement.
Zandalarian Shadow Talisman ( 1 )
completion: This is the last time we will speak under the auspices of Shera Ali'kh. You know all that you must. Take the talisman and continue in your slaying. Hakkar must never be allowed to leave Zul'Gurub.

name: The Maelstrom's Tendril
completion: Amongst the Zandalarians, the profession of $C is revered. Our greatest hunters travel to the edge of the Maelstrom to prove their resolution. $B From the heart of the sea they pull strands of kelp known as Maelstrom Tendrils. The kelp is then woven into a talisman that is enchanted to improve their accuracy and power. $B I now grant you a single weaving of the Maelstrom's Tendril. As your bond with Zandalar grows, I shall weave more power into the talisman.

name: The Maelstrom's Tendril
progress:
Ah, $N , it is good to smell you again. $B You'll have to excuse my sense of humor. It can be most foul at times. $B I sense that you have caused great anguish to our enemies. The forces of Hakkar cry out your name in anger. This is most excellent. $B You have earned another weave on your talisman. Hand it to me.
Maelstrom's Tendril ( 1 )
completion: Let them seek atonement at the end of your munitions.

name: The Maelstrom's Tendril
progress:
Even from here I can hear the sound of your volleys laying waste to our enemies. Their cries echo in agony. $B You have made quite a name for yourself among the trolls of Zandalar, $N . We are grateful for all that you have done. $B Hand me your talisman so that I may add another weave.
Maelstrom's Tendril ( 1 )
completion: There is only one more weave that I will be able to add to your talisman, $C .

name: Zulian, Razzashi, and Hakkari Coins
progress:
I seek the Paragons of Power known as the Coins of the Tribes. They are the currency used by the various denizens of Zul'Gurub, and each is imbued with subtle but powerful mojo. $B There are nine distinct kinds to be found. Some are sought after by my compatriots for various armors they offer Zandalar heroes. Should you have any extra, I will trade you one of our Honor Tokens for a set of three. You may use the Tokens with Rin'wosho the Trader; he offers our heroes special items for them.
Zulian Coin ( 1 )
Razzashi Coin ( 1 )
Hakkari Coin ( 1 )
completion: Excellent - this set of coins will make a fine addition to our growing collection... one that we will use in the tribe's defense against the rise of the Blood God. You've earned this Honor Token, $N , as well as the thanks of the tribe!

name: Essence Mangoes
progress:
The extremely potent essence mango grows across many of the islands in the South Seas. A single mango will refresh those who eat it, both physically and mentally. If you've never had one, you do yourself a disservice! $B We have enough of a supply here on the isle to offer you a handful in exchange for a Zandalar Honor Token. Speak with Vinchaxa if you need to learn how to get tokens; otherwise, let's get to the business at hand!
Zandalar Honor Token ( 1 )
Zandalar Tribe ( Honored )
completion: A fair trade, my friend - please enjoy the luscious fruits of the South Seas, with the tribe's blessing.

It doesn't matter what it is - you could take a broken chair leg and make it glow, and every child will come from miles around to get one! $B So, $N , I need glowing scorpid blood. You can find it from the scorpids of Sillithus, or the Blasted Lands, or the Burning Steppes.
