name: Mortal Champions
progress:
We sense the presence of our enslaved brethren deeper inside Ahn'Qiraj; yet not even an army of dragons would be enough to rescue them, $R . $B The same spell that imprisoned them would place us firmly under C'Thun's control should we come any closer to him. $B The Old God has foreseen our arrival. All hope is lost. What difference could a mere mortal like you possibly make?
Qiraji Lord's Insignia ( 1 )
completion: I see that you're no ordinary mortal, $N . Your chances against the Old God, however infinitely small, are greater than ours at this point. After all, while he expects dragons at his doorstep, he is not prepared for someone like you. $B Just as Anachronos and Staghelm defeated the Qiraji a thousand years ago through the alliance of mortal and dragon races, we too shall form a pact. Gain the trust of the Bronze Dragonflight and you'll gain our trust. Only then we shall make a true champion out of you.

name: The Horde Needs More Firebloom!
progress:
Pele'keiki know you come to help. Bring many firebloom and make him very happy. Pele'keiki might make big bombs with firebloom. Drop them on insects from his bat over Ahn'Qiraj when war come. But Pele'keiki need more firebloom, $C ! $B You gonna bring Pele'keiki that firebloom, real quick now. Come back with at least as much as last time, and Pele'keiki be pleased.
Firebloom ( 20 )
completion: This no joke, $C ? You bring Pele'keiki firebloom that fast? Pele'keiki count them up right now, mon! You makin' Pele'keiki so happy, he be tellin' everyone, $N best firebloom collector ever! Pele'keiki can't wait for war to start. Now we really light up the sky over Silithus, right, bruddah?!

name: The Horde Needs More Purple Lotus!
progress:
In fact it does appear that we are in need of even more purple lotus, $C . While my own studies have yet to determine a new useful application for the herb, there are tried and true methodologies yet to be employed. $B I need you to once again go out into the field and collect at least twenty purple lotus samples. Return them to me here.
Purple Lotus ( 20 )
completion: Excellent and precise work, $N . Your diligence is to be commended, as is your celerity. I will personally see to it that none of these purple lotus go to waste. $B Thank you again, and should you come by more purple lotus do not hesitate to bring them to me with utmost haste.

name: The Horde Needs More Heavy Leather!
progress:
It's true, $C , I still need more heavy leather. The requests from the generals and their quartermasters seem endless. And that's nothing compared to what the zeppelin masters are asking for! $B I need to get my quota collected on the double. $N , bring me more stacks of heavy leather as soon as you can!
Heavy Leather ( 10 )
completion: You da mon, mon! Thank you so much for the heavy leather. Every little bit gets us that much closer. I'll just get these onto a pile so that the other leatherworkers can get to work on them. $B Thanks again, $N , and if you come across more stacks of heavy leather, you know where you can find me.

name: The Horde Needs More Thick Leather!
progress:
$C , as you can see I still need to gather up more thick leather. Once again I ask your help with this task, and promise that if you complete it, you will be recognized for your efforts. $B Time is of the essence! Return to me with the thick leather so that we can finish our preparations and go to war, hero!
Thick Leather ( 10 )
completion: You did it, $N , I knew that you would! Once again, thank you on behalf of the entire Horde. Your efforts have been noted and are greatly appreciated. And if you find yourself with more thick leather that you'd like to donate, bring them to me here. $B Lok'tar Ogar, $C !

name: Tiara of the Oracle
details: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity. They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos. $B In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns. But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs. $B Bring me the components I require, $N . I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
progress: Did you bring me the components I asked for, $N ?
completion: You've succeeded! The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased. $B Take this as a reward. The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.

name: Trousers of the Oracle
details: You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal? Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance. $B The ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power. He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life. $B His skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature. $B Bring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
progress: Did you bring the components I require, $N ?
completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer. Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor. May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!

name: Mantle of the Oracle
details: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon. $B Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
progress: Have you collected the components I require?
completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal. May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.

name: Mortal Champions
progress:
Killing one Qiraji lord is a notable accomplishment for a mortal, $N . They are however, numerous and powerful. Continue to defeat them to prove your worth as our champion.
Qiraji Lord's Insignia ( 1 )
completion: You continue to serve us well, $N . Our pact remains in place.

name: Footwraps of the Oracle
details: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient. The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon. $B Bring me the qiraji bindings of command and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you. $B You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
progress: You've acquired the items I requested, $N ?
completion: You've done well, $N . You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. $B I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.

name: The Horde Needs More Rugged Leather!
progress:
Preparations for the impending war at Ahn'Qiraj are proceeding, $C . However, to ensure that we do not fall behind, or at least that I am not the one that causes us to fall behind, I want for you to bring back another stack of rugged leather. Your prompt attention to this matter will be greatly appreciated, $N .
Rugged Leather ( 10 )
completion: Practice, practice, practice. A well honed knife and the skill to use it will get you far in this world, $N . Looks like the edges on these skins are better than the last. Did you buy a new knife? $B In any case, we thank you for your efforts. Your donation has been noted, and will be put to good use I can assure you. Should you find yourself in the possession of more rugged leather, be sure to come back and speak with me, as I will probably need it.

name: Stormcaller's Pauldrons
details: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon. $B Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
progress: Have you collected the components I require?
completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal. May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.

name: Vestments of the Oracle
details: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj. The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power. $B When the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath. You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end. $B Do this and bring me a piece of his husk. I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
progress: At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
completion: I did not expect you to return from your attempt, $N . $B You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings. $B By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension. $B Accept these vestments as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions. $B May their power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!

name: The Horde Needs More Wool Bandages!
progress:
Good to see you again, $C . We are still working on preparations here for the war effort, and I can still use all of the help that you can give in gathering up wool bandaging. Any assistance at all will be greatly appreciated. I only hope that our efforts will be good enough. I've lost too many noble souls on the battlefields of yesterday to not do everything in my power to see to it that doesn't happen again.
Wool Bandage ( 20 )
completion: You are an honorable $C , $N ! I will see to it that these bandages get into the right hands. You have my thanks, and that of the Horde. $B Go in peace, and return to me again should you find yourself with excess wool bandaging. We can use all of the help that we can get here.

name: The Horde Needs More Mageweave Bandages!
progress:
You returned? Interesting. As you can see I am still collecting for the Ahn'Qiraj 'war effort'. Which means that I need you to once again go out and collect a stack of mageweave bandages for me. I look forward to your return, $C .
Mageweave Bandage ( 20 )
completion: Astounding, $C , you actually did it again! Well, they do say that I have good taste in those that I choose to place in my service. Very well, your contribution is noted and you will receive the social benefits that your efforts have afforded. I suggest though that you go back out and gather yet another bundle of mageweave bandages if you truly wish to prove your worth.

name: The Horde Needs More Runecloth Bandages!
progress:
Ever does the time grow nearer when we shall launch ourselves headlong into the conflagration at Ahn'Qiraj, $C . But first we must gather our strength and prepare so that we can survive the onslaught of the insects and their masters. $B If you are here again, then surely you wish to make another contribution of runecloth bandages to the war effort? Please do so as soon as you can and return to me once more.
Runecloth Bandage ( 20 )
completion: It is a very selfless act of giving that you perform, $N . One that is likely to save the lives of many combatants at Ahn'Qiraj. Thank you and know that you have the appreciation of the Horde for your donation. Should you create, or come across, more runecloth bandages, please consider bringing them to me here.

name: The Horde Needs More Lean Wolf Steaks!
progress:
As you can see, $C , we still need to pack away more food for the soldiers. I don't know if you've ever been in a war before, but once you get past the initial shock of the battlefield, you can get pretty hungry. You did a good job last time, so I expect that you'll do as well, if not a little quicker, in getting me another stack of those lean wolf steaks.
Lean Wolf Steak ( 20 )
completion: Smells like you, or someone you know, are quite the cook, $N . Those lean wolf steaks are making my mouth water; I suppose a few going missing won't be noticed. Anyway, good work. I'll make sure someone packs them away right so that they don't spoil too much. $B If you come across more, you know where to find me.

name: The Horde Needs More Spotted Yellowtail!
progress:
So as you can see, we still be needin' a lot of the fishies. The combatants in the upcomin' Ahn'Qiraj War gonna be needin' a lot to eat, so I needin' to get all the spotted yellowtail that I can. You catch 'em, cook 'em, and bringin' 'em back to me here, and I be givin' you thanks, and the thanks of the Horde.
Spotted Yellowtail ( 20 )
completion: That be the best catch yet, $N ! Good, honest work right there. And no bones too! Thanks goin' out to you for this spotted yellowtail here mon. Come back soon if you cookin' up some more!

name: The Horde Needs More Baked Salmon!
progress:
The last batch of baked salmon that you donated to the war effort looked very delicious, $C . I must admit that I was tempted to take a few for myself. As you can tell, we have not yet reached our quota here. I am hoping you have returned because you have another stack of baked salmon with you.
Baked Salmon ( 20 )
completion: Your donation of time and energy to the war effort goes above and beyond, $N . I assure you that your labors have not gone unnoticed. You have my thanks, and the gratitude of the Horde. Please return to me again should you bake up another batch.

The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon. $B Bring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you. $B You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
progress: You've acquired the items I requested, $N ?
completion: You've done well, $N . You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. $B I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.

name: Striker's Hauberk
details: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj. The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power. $B When the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath. You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end. $B Do this and bring me a piece of his husk. I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
progress: At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
completion: I did not expect you to return from your attempt, $N . $B You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings. $B By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension. $B Accept this breastplate as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions. $B May its power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!

name: Striker's Diadem
details: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity. They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos. $B In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns. But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs. $B Bring me the components I require, $N . I will make you a headpiece of unmatched power.
progress: Did you bring me the components I asked for, $N ?
completion: You've succeeded! The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased. $B Take this as a reward. The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.

name: Striker's Leggings
details: You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal? Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance. $B The ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power. He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life. $B His skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature. $B Bring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
progress: Did you bring the components I require, $N ?
completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer. Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor. May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!

name: Striker's Pauldrons
details: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon. $B Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
progress: Have you collected the components I require?
completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal. May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.

name: Field Duty
details: Greetings, $N . Before I assign you to more involved tasks in the war, you'll need to do your share of field duty. $B You will find Captain Skullsplit's Orgrimmar Legion outside Hive'Regal. $B Report to him and come back to me with proof of your field service. I shall have a more advanced assignment ready for you. $B Oh, please do your best to stay away from the Ironforge Brigade. Tensions are high among our Alliance and Horde volunteers.
progress: You've completed your field duty, $N ? Captain Skullsplit can be found outside of Hive'Regal.
completion: I can tell that Krug has little use for paperwork. He signed this in silithid blood! $B Very well, $N . I've prepared a set of tasks that should make good use of your skills as a $C . $B With the continued efforts of you and people like you, our enemy will soon be crushed!

name: Field Duty Papers
progress:
Field duty papers? What manner of nonsense is this, $N ?
Prepared Field Duty Papers ( 1 )
completion: In the old days I would've marked your forehead with the creature's blood to mark your accomplishment here. Thrall insists we comply with the Druids' requests. $B Here, take these papers and go back to Cenarion Hold. I'm sure they will have suitable work for you.

name: Azure Templar
details: The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside. $B Find a way to summon and destroy an Azure Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
progress: Is your task done yet, $N ?
completion: Good job, $N . Here's your next assignment.

name: Hive'Regal Scout Report
details: We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence. Scout Landion has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Regal for several days now. Find him and obtain a written report. We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, $N .
progress: You'll find Scout Landion inside Hive'Regal. Hurry, $N ! Time is of the essence.
completion: Your efforts are greatly appreciated, $N . I'll read these scouting reports right away, feel free to go over your next assignment.

completion: Your efforts are greatly appreciated, $N . I'll read these scouting reports right away, feel free to go over your next assignment.

name: Twilight Marauders
details: Bands of mounted Twilight's Hammer cultists have been spotted riding outside the reach of our forces in Cenarion Hold, picking off our smaller patrols and caravans. $B Find and defeat the twilight marauders along with their leader, a terrible warrior by the name of Morna. Report to Windcaller Proudhorn after completing the task.
progress: Is your task done yet, $N ?
completion: Well done, $N . The twilight marauders were inflicting an unacceptable number of casualties on our patrols. Here's your next assignment.

name: Bang a Gong!
progress:
The Scarab Gong looms ominously before you. Steel yourself, $N ; for once The Scarab Gong is rung, the gates of Ahn'Qiraj will be opened. $B From the slackened maw of the beast can only come chaos and destruction. Defend your people!
The Scepter of the Shifting Sands ( 1 )

You've been selected to partake on an assault on Hive'Regal where your primary target will consist of the airborne Hive'Regal spitfires. $B Report back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.
progress: You wish to tell me something, $N ?
completion: Excellent work, $N . Your part in the attack on Hive'Regal has been noted.

name: The Ironforge Brigade Needs Explosives!
details: The Ironforge Brigade has put in an unusual request for highly... volatile... components. Gather them and bring them to Mr. Nozzlespring from the Ironforge Brigade.
progress: You have something for me, $N ?
completion: Ah, yes! These will come in handy! Much obliged, $N !

name: Scrying Materials
details: Geologist Larksbane's studies have proven to be of tremendous value to our operations in Silithus. She has recently requested scrying materials to be used in her research. $B Please gather these materials and deliver them to her directly so that she may continue her research.
progress: You have something for me, $N ?
completion: Why, yes... these will be of tremendous aid! These materials are awfully hard to come by in the desert, $N . Thank you.

name: Armor Kits for the Field
details: The Ironforge Brigade's supply of armor kits in the battlefield is running dangerously low. Obtain a batch and deliver them to Janela Stouthammer at the Ironforge Brigade's outpost outside Hive'Zora.
progress: You have something for me, $N ?
completion: Thanks, I'll hand these out to the lads.

name: Arms for the Field
details: The Ironforge Brigade has been a worthy ally in our fight in Silithus. Unfortunately, many of their supplies were lost on their way here. Procure a batch of weapons and deliver them to Janela Stouthammer near Hive'Zora.
progress: You have something for me, $N ?
completion: Oh, excellent! I won't have to hear complaints about dull blades anymore. Thank you, $N .

name: Uniform Supplies
details: The latest influx of volunteers has caused a shortage of uniforms. Procure a batch of uniform materials and bring them to Windcaller Proudhorn.
progress: You have something for me, $N ?
completion: Ah, we were in need of these. Your work is appreciated, $N .

name: Extraordinary Materials
details: Vargus, Cenarion Hold's blacksmith, has requested enchanted materials to be used in the crafting of powerful weapons for our forces. Obtain these and bring them directly to Vargus so that Cenarion Hold's troops may continue to be well equipped.
progress: You have something for me, $N ?
completion: Ah, yes. These materials are of excellent quality. Thank you, $N .

name: Secrets of the Qiraji
details: You have discovered an ancient Qiraji artifact! Perhaps one of the dragons near the entrance of the temple would have a use for this relic.
progress: You're glowing! I know what that means...
completion: An exceptional find, $N . Simply marvelous! This will definitely give us some insight into our enemy's twisted minds.

name: The Orgrimmar Legion Needs Mojo!
details: The Orgrimmar Legion has put in a request for several unusual ingredients. Given their current performance in Silithus, we'd like to comply with their request as soon as possible. Gather the materials and bring them to the troll called Shai.
progress: Do you have my materials, $N ?
completion: Ah, yes. Just what I needed! I'll make a special concoction with this. The silithid won't like it one bit!

name: Arms for the Field
details: The Orgrimmar Legion has put in a request for additional weapons that we haven't been able to provide at the moment. Obtain the weapons they've requested and bring them to Merok Longstride outside of Hive'Regal.
progress: You have something for me, $N ?
completion: Excellent work. We were in short supply of these, $N .

name: Armor Kits for the Field
details: The brave volunteers of the Orgrimmar Legion have arrived to Silithus to aid us in our cause. Their supplies of armor kits were somehow lost in the trip. Obtain a batch of armor kits and deliver them to Merok Longstride at the location of the Orgrimmar Legion camp.
progress: You have something for me, $N ?
completion: Ah, yes... I will distribute these to the troops, $N . The Orgrimmar Legion thanks you!

name: A Gently Shaken Gift
completion: This present looks like it has been shaken a few times. The tag on it reads: $B To a very special $R $C .

name: Imperial Qiraji Armaments
details: We have not sat idly by for a millennium, $N . $B We have watched these beasts feast on their own when they have exhausted their utility. We have listened as they have plotted and schemed to destroy our world. And we have learned of their own internal treachery. $B Weaknesses exist and we know how to use those weaknesses to our advantage. $B Find and bring me their ceremonial armaments: Combined with the element created from the volatility of their own God, they will become a force of reckoning.
progress: Seek out what I requested. You will become greater than the sum of your parts, champion.
completion: Infused with Elementium, these weapons will cut through the Qiraji and their God with incredible ease.

name: Imperial Qiraji Regalia
details: Arygos theorizes that the element which is born of conflicts between the Old Gods and their minions is also extremely deadly to them under the right conditions. I speak of Elementium, mortal. $B Find and bring me Imperial Qiraji Regalia and the toxic element and I shall infuse weapons of great power.
progress: You will strike them down and free us of these bonds.
completion: Use the item well, $N . Let them feel the pain that they so dearly wish to inflict upon others.

name: The Alliance Needs Your Help!
details: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Alliance needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $N ! $B You should go speak with the guy in charge, Field Marshal Snowfall. What do you say, $C ? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
completion: Hail and well met lad! Good to see so many of the Alliance, such as yourself, $N , coming out to lend your support in laying the groundwork for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War. The effort here will ensure that we are victorious against the Silithid and their evil masters hidden away inside Ahn'Qiraj. $B So now that you are here, be sure to speak with the various collectors and offer your assistance in gathering those materials that you are suited to.

name: A Yeti of Your Own
completion: Say! You know what?! You're an engineer too! So, since you helped me teach my friends a lesson, I'm going to teach you how to make your very own mechanical yeti! Now the fun can go on forever and ever, and you can scare whoever you want! Provided that you can scare up the components to make it that is. $B What do you say, $N ? Do you want to learn the secret to making a mechanical yeti?

name: A Festive Gift
completion: The note on this present reads: $B To $N , $B In hoping this will help you spread warm tidings and holiday cheer to all of Azeroth. $B From Greatfather Winter

name: Desert Survival Kits
details: With the arrival of fresh recruits to Cenarion Hold comes the problem of keeping them alive in the desert. Dehydration as well as numerous poisonous creatures present a serious threat to inexperienced volunteers. Gather the supplies necessary for a desert survival kit and bring them to Calandrath in Cenarion Hold.
progress: You have something for me?
completion: Excellent! We were in need of these, $N . Thanks.

name: The Ultimate Deception
details: The Twilight's Hammer operates through innumerable layers of secrecy and deceit. While their actions are carried out in our world, they are planned in a place we have not yet been able to reach. $B We've come to believe that the stones the Twilight's Hammer uses to summon their superiors allow for two-way transportation. To attempt to use them in this manner, we must replicate - to every last detail - a twilight emissary's robe. $B Gather the necessary materials and bring them to Aurel Goldleaf, $N .
progress: You have something for me?
completion: Yes, I believe these shall suffice. I shall craft these into the colors worn by the Twilight Hammer's emissaries. I pray to Elune that my skills will be able to fool our enemies once more. $B But do not be concerned with that, you've done your part and for that you will be appropriately rewarded. You are a loyal and worthy ally, $N .

For those adventurers who have but a single commendation signet, I'll exchange it for a small amount of recognition with Stormwind. $B Please bear in mind that it is better to hand over a stack of ten signets at once; your efforts will receive greater recognition in doing so. We offer a single signet exchange as a service for those who don't have enough for a full stack of ten. $B With that being said, I stand ready to assist you if you still wish to hand in a single signet.
Alliance Commendation Signet ( 1 )
completion: Very well - your deeds have been entered into the records, and you are duly recognized for your efforts. Keep up the good work, $C . $B If you have any more signets to hand in, then I am able to assist you further in that regard.

name: Ten Commendation Signets
progress:
I accept commendation signets from adventurers who have received them in the line of duty. For each set of ten that you hand to me, I'll make sure that you receive a significant acknowledgement of your deeds with Stormwind. I also accept single tokens, but at a much reduced rate of recognition. We are much more interested in greater feats of duty, though no feat will be ignored. $B With that said, I'll gladly take your signets if you are ready to hand in a set.
Alliance Commendation Signet ( 10 )
completion: Excellent! It is no small sacrifice that you've made to earn these signets, and you will be acknowledged for your service appropriately. It's adventurers like you, $N , that truly make a difference. $B Let me know if you have additional signets to hand in; I'll gladly help you out with whatever ones you need exchanged.

progress:

Well, I can certainly understand the need for additional materiel... just take a look around if you need any proof. $B I'll issue you some additional supplies, but you'll need to give me an appropriate number of commendation signets in exchange. completion: Well then, it's settled; here are your supplies, $C . If you wish to do an additional exchange, then I am prepared to authorize it. Just give me the word and I'll make it happen. $B Keep up the good work, $N . We need all the materiel we can muster if we're going to win this thing. If we all do our part, then victory shall be ours for the taking!

name: Desert Survival Kits
details: With the arrival of fresh recruits to Cenarion Hold comes the problem of keeping them alive in the desert. Dehydration as well as numerous poisonous creatures present a serious threat to inexperienced volunteers. Gather the supplies necessary for a desert survival kit and bring them to Calandrath in Cenarion Hold.

name: Elune's Candle
progress:
Elune's candle is an artifact of great reverence to the disciples of the Lunar Festival. Stored within the candle is true moonlight, ready to be unleashed! $B This light is harmless to most creatures, but you will find that Omen and his minions are burned and dazzled by it.
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Very well then - I accept these coins of ancestry. Please take Elune's candle with my blessing. Also, please enjoy these complimentary fireworks. $B May your Lunar Festival be joyous and filled with merriment, $N . $B And if you choose to face Omen and his minions, you will find Elune's candle quite useful...

name: Festival Dumplings
progress:
If you are hungry, then you have come to the right place my friend! $B Dumplings are the traditional food of the Lunar Festival; it has been served since the time of the first Lunar Festival, and I am pleased to be able to offer it at this one. In exchange for just a single coin of ancestry, I will share with you a sampling of one of the tastiest dishes you will ever enjoy!
Coin of Ancestry ( 1 )
completion: Excellent - please enjoy these dumplings with my compliments. While they are but a small token of appreciation for the honor you have brought upon yourself through your actions, I think you will enjoy them all the same. $B Should you have any more coins of ancestry, I stand ready to offer you a wide array of items in exchange.

name: Festive Lunar Dresses
progress:
I have a selection of dresses that may be of interest to you. Such dresses have been worn in times past during the Lunar Festival, and the selection I have today is perhaps the finest I have ever seen. Each is hand-crafted with only the finest and softest of components. $B In exchange for some coins of ancestry, I will let you choose one of the three styles I have to keep as your own. Is this acceptable to you?
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Very well then - I accept these coins of ancestry. Please take your dress with my blessing. Also, please enjoy these complimentary fireworks. $B As you have honored your elders, you honor me with your mere presence. Thank you, and may your Lunar Festival be joyous.

name: Festive Lunar Pant Suits
progress:
I am please to inform you that I have a fine selection of festive pant suits available for you to own... but only in trade for coins of ancestry. If fashion is important to you, then these are what you're looking for! I assure you that you will not find pant suits like these anywhere else. $B In exchange for some coins of ancestry, I will let you choose one of the three styles I have to keep as your own. Is this acceptable to you?
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Very well then - I accept these coins of ancestry. Please take your pant suit with my blessing. Also, please enjoy these complimentary fireworks. $B Should you have more coins of ancestry to trade, then speak with me again. I will be offering various items throughout the entirety of the Lunar Festival.

name: Bronzebeard the Elder
completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, $N , and offer you this token...

name: Sweet Serenity
details: Within the confines of the Scarlet Bastion lies sweet Serenity. The Crimson Hammersmith guards the recipe with his life. Defeat him and bring me his apron. For that, I shall train you to become a hammersmith. $B Understand this: Once you have chosen the path of the hammersmith, the paths of the swordsmith and axesmith will no longer be available.

name: Small Rockets
progress:
I hold the secrets to creating Lunar Festival rockets, and I am happy to share my knowledge with the honored. $B In exchange for coins of ancestry, I can offer you the recipe to make a small rocket...
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Ah, very well. Here are your recipes, $N , and my Elune bless you.

name: Firework Launcher
progress:
Although rockets are a wonderful way to celebrate, in order to see their glory... they must be fired from a launcher. $B Bring me coins of ancestry and I can offer you the knowledge to create rocket launchers like the ones you see in Moonglade.
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Here you are, $N . Here is the schematic to create a firework launcher. Place launchers where you wish to celebrate, and then welcome your friends to join you!

name: Festive Recipes
progress:
The dresses and pant suits you see are traditional clothes from many years past. They are worn in honor of old ways and loved ones gone. $B If you bring me coins of ancestry, $N , then I will give you the pattern to create traditional red dresses or suits.
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Here are the patterns, $N . I am sure you will find the product of this knowledge quite beautiful.

name: Large Rockets
progress:
Large Festival rockets light up the sky brilliantly - only the cluster rockets rival their magnificence! $B Bring me coins of ancestry, $N , and I shall share the knowledge of their creation.
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Very well - I accept these coins of ancestry. Here are your recipes, $N . May you use them to spread Elune's glory!

name: Cluster Rockets
progress:
Cluster rockets are a collection of individual rockets, and their beauty is awesome! Bring me coins of ancestry and I will share the knowledge of their creation to you...
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Here you are, $N . Take these recipes and learn their secrets. I bid you fortune, and I look forward to seeing your magnificent creations.

name: Large Cluster Rockets
progress:
Large cluster rockets require vast resources and skill to create, but their brilliance and beauty is worth that effort! Bring me coins of ancestry and I will grant you the knowledge of their crafting.
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Thank you, $N . Here is the recipe for large cluster rockets. May your products bring joy and luck to all those who gaze up them.

name: Cluster Launcher
progress:
The most splendid fireworks shows must include cluster rockets, and those cluster rockets must be fired from cluster launchers! Is it not then logical for you to learn the secrets of making cluster launchers? Bring me coins of ancestry and I will give this knowledge to you.
Coin of Ancestry ( 5 )
completion: Here is your schematic. Study it closely, and learn... $B Good luck, $N . May your celebrations rival that of the Lunar Festival itself!

name: The Super Egg-O-Matic
progress:
The Super Egg-O-Matic is the latest of Curgle Cranklehop's inventions. It is quite an impressive piece of machinery. $B The Super Egg-O-Matic sputters wildly as you approach the control panel.
Hippogryph Egg ( 1 )
completion: You place the hippogryph egg into the machine. A series of beeps follows along with some strange mechanical sounds. $B It appears that the Eggometer has weighed, measured, and packaged your egg. Now that's speedy service!

name: Gift Giving
progress:
Have you come to deliver a present of love and adoration to your favorite leader?
Horde Gift Collection ( 1 )
completion: Wonderful! Wonderful! I will add this to the pile of other gifts. $B I didn't expect so many! You must truly love your leaders. $B Now, let me just add one more to the count...

name: Frostfire Robe
details: As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire. $B It's all in here and I am willing to share the fruits of that knowledge with you as long as you are able to provide me with the necessary materials.
progress: With the proper materials and reagents, I am able to reform the mythical Frostfire armor.
completion: Do not forget that power left unchecked is as destructive as power left unused, $C . Use discretion when donning Frostfire.

name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
details: This final task will be the most difficult of all, $N . You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras. $B Take the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.

name: Traitor to the Bloodsail
progress:
That mangy dog, Revilgaz, has offered to pardon any former Bloodsails willing to turn on their cap'n! That bilge sucker asked me to go an' off me ole' mates and to bring back their bandannas as proof. $B I don't have it in me heart to do that, nor will I ask ye to. Bring me some silk cloth and red dye and I'll make suitable replicas. I'll tell the Baron you went turncoat, but be warned... the Bloodsails are not gonna like it!
Silk Cloth ( 40 )
Red Dye ( 4 )
completion: Let us observe a minute of silence for our fallen mates, $N . $B Being a traitor is one thing, murdering yer own buckos... that'd be just downright despicable, aye!

name: Making Amends
progress:
You must've done something really bad to us or our friends, $N . At any rate, I'm here to offer you a way to get our good graces back. $B As you know, Winterspring is quite cold. With so many of us goblins coming from other cities, we could use a hand keeping warm. Bring me some runecloth and coal and I'll put in the good word for ya. Be warned though, our enemies are not going to take kindly to your helping us.
Runecloth ( 40 )
Coal ( 4 )
completion: Thank you, $N . You're on a quick path to redeeming yourself with our fair town.

name: Mending Old Wounds
progress:
You'd better think twice before setting foot in Ratchet, $N ! Word's been getting around of your dirty deeds. $B You're in luck though, a ship just arrived with many wounded from an encounter with the Bloodsail Buccaneers. This is your chance to prove you're not a complete scoundrel. Lend us a hand by bringing linen cloth for bandages and empty vials for potions.
Linen Cloth ( 40 )
Empty Vial ( 4 )
completion: I'm happy you're seeing the error of your ways, $N . Keep the supplies coming; we're not going to forget about you so easily, mister!

name: War at Sea
progress:
You seek to befriend the goblins of Tanaris once again, $N ? We're in need of materials for sails and guns to fight off our old enemies, the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Bring me mageweave and strong flux and we'll be on our way to pardoning your trespasses.
Mageweave Cloth ( 40 )
Strong Flux ( 4 )
completion: Keep it coming, $N . Us goblins don't forget that easily!

Cenarion Logistics Badge ( 1 )
Cenarion Tactical Badge ( 1 )

name: A Thief's Reward
details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the (NAME) might know more...
completion: You've proven yourself today, $N . $B While I have little else to give you, I do have this crown; a fitting gift for a conqueror. May it light your way.

progress:
You have aided our cause greatly, $N . If you wish, I can make available the tabard of the Argent Dawn. We are proud to have you among our allies.
Necrotic Rune ( 10 )
completion: Take this tabard and wear it proudly. Perhaps your deeds might inspire others to take up arms in support of our fight against the Scourge.

name: A Light in Dark Places
details: An eager one, aren't you? If you're willing to enter the depths once more, I'll gladly reward you. $B Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I look forward to your return, $N .

name: Hearts of the Lovers
details: An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure. $B My scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally. $B In Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet. $B They toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.
progress: Ah, $N , you return. Were you able to procure the lovers' hearts?
completion: As expected. Excellently done, $N . $B Idiots.

name: Love Hurts
details:
A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.

The demon must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion.

If you trust a blind man to lead you, $N , then listen. East from the Cleft of Shadow, along the main drag of Orgrimmar, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge.

Seek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.
completion: Who told you about Krilge? Have you come with any news? You better not be toying with me...

name: What Is Love?
details:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
progress: You've returned. Successfully, I assume?
completion: <Gakin turns the wooden figurine over in his hand.> $B I sense the emotional energy residing within this artifact, undiminished by the passing of time. The incubus will be drawn to it like a fly to honey. $B Takar never disappoints.

name: Wish You Were Here
details:
I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...

They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.

We would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.

I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
progress: Yes, what is it?
completion: What is it you have there, $N ? A scarf made of... Mooncloth? You best not be seeking to romance me.

name: Stalk With The Earthmother
details: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, shaman. Use this mask to infilrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.
progress: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, $C . I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
completion: Hmm... perhaps disguises are not your strength.

name: Stalk With The Earthmother
details:
I speak to you from your future, when the Horde faces threats you cannot imagine. Since the others cannot see me, I rely on you to learn my skills and pass them to the tribe.

Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
progress: Be careful with the salve once you are finished, $C . Even skin contact could be quite painful.
completion: $C , this is not the venomous salve I asked for. What you have brought me is pine nut butter. Are you sure you followed my instructions? $B This will be of far more use spread on some spice bread than on a dagger. Although you would be quite formidable against a foe with a nut allergy.

name: Stalk With The Earthmother
details:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
progress: Do you have something for me?
completion: That was quite a display, $C . Not the rogueish precision I hoped for, but you possess an impressive ambidexterity. $B I see now that you will not be the one to train my people in the subtle arts, but there is one thing I can teach you. Good luck on your travels, $C . The Horde will need heroes like you.

name: A Strange Artifact
progress:
Did you find something in the tower?
Althalaxx Orb ( 1 )
completion: You were right to bring this to me, $N .

name: Advice From Stormwind
details: I sense a dark power within this orb, but its source eludes me. We need advice from the paladins of Stormwind. Bring the orb to them.
progress: You bring news from Kalimdor?

name: A Second Opinion
details:
I'm not sure what to make of this orb, $N . I think we will need the help of... a specialist.

We are aware of a warlock sect operating out of Stormwind. Officially we reject the presence of warlocks in the city. Unofficially, their knowledge can be of use when dealing with demonic forces.

Find a representative of these warlocks, and seek their opinion on the orb.
progress: You're a long way from the cathedral, $C . I hope you realize you have no authority here.
completion: So the Silver Hand requires my aid? It will not come cheaply.

name: Earning Your Salt
details:
I will study the orb and tell you what I learn, but you must first do something for me.

The warlocks of the Blackrock clan use specially prepared salts to enhance their summoning rituals. Collect some from the orcs in Redridge.

When you return, I will share with you the results of my studies.
completion: Ah... the salts. I had forgotten all about them. $B This orb is unlike anything I have seen, $N .

name: It Must Be Destroyed
details:
This orb is indeed connected to a powerful entity, somewhere beyond the Twisting Nether. I cannot divine its nature, but I feel its perception reaching through the orb... studying me in return.

I am reluctant to admit this, $N , but the orb must be destroyed.

It seems impervious to most damage, but it may be vulnerable to the weapon of a powerful demon lord. I am unsure where you will find such a weapon, but it remains your best option.

Good luck, $N .

name: Return to Delgren
details: <The shattered remains of the orb lay at your feet. Delgren will want to see you have succeeded.>
progress: Did you find a way to destroy the orb?
completion: This is a relief, $N . But whatever was watching Azeroth through that orb... I have a feeling they will not be happy it was destroyed. $B Take this as my thanks for your efforts. And... be careful.

name: The Eye of Bhossca
details:
Glad to have you back, $N .

The latest object of my desire is an artifact known as the Eye of Bhossca. My sources tell me the eye is somewhere within the Scarlet Monastery. As with Shadowfang Keep, you must infiltrate the monastery alone.

It may behoove you to find a disguise before going in. It will make getting around a touch easier. I'm sure you could find something on the monastery's grounds.

Return the eye here, and payment will be delivered as before.

- C
completion: <You place The Eye of Bhossca into the chest>

name: Terror of the Desert Skies
details: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.
completion: Well now. This is certainly interesting...

name: Terror of the Desert Skies
details:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.
progress: How goes the hunt? Surely the bird hasn't got you beat!
completion: Now there's a feather for your cap! Nicely done, $N . $B You can rest here for a while, if you like. I'm sure your trek through the desert was arduous.

name: Stepping Stones
details: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
completion: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.

name: No Honor Among Thieves
details:
As I was saying...

Our boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.

Once the Marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.

I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout somewhere near Arathi.
progress: <Using Illari's key, you unlock the cache.>
completion: <Inside of the cache, you find a small box, along with some coin.>

name: Elemental Aid
details: I've heard of Hirzek, and the barbaric lengths they have gone to manipulate the elements. $B <Rau's eyes wander as he ponders the note, speaking to himself aloud.> $B The storm will rage, the ground will rumble, and the tide will rise... $B <Rau's eyes focus you and widen as he comes to the realization.> $B They must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek. They plan to flood the canyon and raise us all into undeath. $B To achieve their goal, I fear they require devastating elemental powers.
completion: <You hand the note to Bath'rah who reads it over and gives a half hearted chuckle.> $B Ah so it be true mon... I too have sensed much unrest in the elemental plane and dis must be one of the causes. $B To flood all da Thousand Needles would take a great storm and many lives be lost. $B I t'ink I got just da t'ing for ya, but it won't come easy.

name: Wet Job
details:
Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time.
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for.
completion: Dwarven Engineering, always a marvel.

name: Eagle's Fist
details:
You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox. Imagining a voice speaking, you read: "From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
completion: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.

name: This Must Be The Place
details:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...
completion: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.

name: Scramble
details: Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going.
completion: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.
